Acid Quake Fonqugon.description:
When Rodnarth's tectonic plates shift and merge, acid spews from cracks in the earth and erupts from volcanoes that spring up suddenly, only to melt themselves just as rapidly when the acid mixes with Rodnarth's lower atmosphere and creates a devastating toxic rain. Exposure to these toxins has wiped out countless species, though some mutate and adapt to resist them—or to sense the earthquakes that cause them.

As an acid quake fonqugon, you're especially attuned to the ground around you and can withstand mild corrosives. You gain imprecise tremorsense with a range of 15 feet and acid resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Acid Quake Fonqugon.name: Acid Quake Fonqugon

Akitonian Kasatha.description: You (or one of your ancestors) traveled to the Pact Worlds on the Idari and settled on Akiton. Akiton's significantly lower gravity grants you an advantage in the fun and practical art of leaping, and you likely revel in the many rituals surrounding the desert world's popular sports. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} feat and don't treat sand as uneven ground.
Akitonian Kasatha.name: Akitonian Kasatha

Akitonian Nomad Shobhad.description: You were born on Akiton to a clan or group that traveled far and wide, never settling in one place for long. The first time you left Akiton, you discovered the planet's lower gravity had given you specific skills and adaptations in the art of leaping and jumping that translated well to battle in space and other strange environs. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feat, even if you aren't trained in Athletics, and don't treat ice or sand as uneven ground.
Akitonian Nomad Shobhad.name: Akitonian Nomad Shobhad

Akitonian Ysoki.description: You or your ancestors grew up on Akiton, scrapping crashed starships or combing junk heaps for treasures. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Crafting and can use Crafting instead of Thievery to Disable a Device. If you're already trained in Crafting, you instead gain the Quick Repair general feat.
Akitonian Ysoki.name: Akitonian Ysoki

Ambassador Brenneri.description:
You excelled in your teenage mediation training and were selected to be a member of the famed ambassador corps.

You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

As an ambassador, you learned how to work in close partnership with your allies. You train one non-minion willing ally to be your ambassador partner by spending 1 week of downtime training with them. You can have only one ambassador partner at a time. If you a train a new ambassador partner, they replace your previous ambassador partner. You and your ambassador partner gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QMxO5Y1b9ORvlogx]{Pardon Me} action.

SFS Note: Ambassador brenneri may choose a party member to be their ambassador partner at the start of a scenario as if they had previously spent 1 week of downtime training them.
Ambassador Brenneri.name: Ambassador Brenneri

Ambassador Formian.description:
You're an ambassador to communities, whether on Castrovel or beyond. You were trained in the tradition of the ancient formian ambassadors whose great and tremendous effort unified the Colonies.

As an ambassador formian, you become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (such as from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Additionally, if you roll a success on a Perception check to [[/act sense-motive]], you get a critical success instead.
Ambassador Formian.name: Ambassador Formian

Ancestor's Armor Osharu.description:
Some modern osharus undergo thaumagenetic alterations to regrow their flexible armplates and regain some of their ancestors' defensive capabilities. The trend has particularly caught on with young osharus swept up in the military fervor that arrived with the sudden presence of Swarm space on Pabaq's cosmic doorstep.

You've undergone the extensive process to develop scaled armplates like your ancestors. Your @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.V4kcwGZw9t2zAW1k]{Armplates} function like @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.j66fZJrm1nECG3UM]{commercial dermal plating} augmentation, except they are a permanent part of your body, don't have the tech trait, and don't take an augmentation slot. You can spend credits to upgrade your armplates as if they were dermal plating. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.m4HQ2o5aPxjXf2kY]{Shield Block} general feat.
Ancestor's Armor Osharu.name: Ancestor's Armor Osharu

Ancient Izalguun.description:
You're an izalguun who recently emerged from stasis, still getting accustomed to the strange new era you find yourself in. You and your fellow ancient izalguuns lived long before the Gap on Agillae-4 using highly advanced technology from your long-lost civilization, but the world you've woken up to differs greatly from the one you left.

Coming from an earlier evolutionary stage, your middle limbs are thinner and lighter than those of modern izalguuns, and you tend to prefer bipedal form. However, you have increased dexterity with your arms, and you understand the ancient technology that you grew up with. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ASy9AKEIRxPYUi5o]{Quick Repair} skill feat.
Ancient Izalguun.name: Ancient Izalguun

Apostae Delver Orc.description:
You hail from the hollow planet Apostae at the fringes of Pact World space. You likely come from a hold plundering the tunnels for ancient alien technology. Sometime during the Gap, your ancestors left Torag's side and arrived on Apostae alongside the Azrinaran elves who now inhabit the lonely world. Many orcs like yourself work in corporate servitude, perhaps paying off debts incurred by ancestors. You might also have recently finished paying off a familial debt and now set out on your own, putting your skills in the tunnels to use. You maybe joined an adventuring company or perhaps looked to form your own corporation.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Apostae Lore. Once per day, if you fail a saving throw against a trap, you can immediately reroll the save. This is a fortune effect.
Apostae Delver Orc.name: Apostae Delver Orc

Aquatic Binnaquid.description: You come from the deepest parts of the swamp, and you are comfortable staying underwater without coming up for air. You might even live in a home that is completely underwater. Your base Swim speed increases to 25 feet, and you gain the amphibious trait.
Aquatic Binnaquid.name: Aquatic Binnaquid

Aquazoan.description: Astrazoans occupying aquatic worlds and communities learn how to integrate gills and fins into their forms and can even manifest these traits when imitating species that do not normally have them. You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet, and you gain the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.
Aquazoan.name: Aquazoan

Arjan Healer Hardor.description: The high-density, pulpy meristematic tissue that makes up hardor leaves has restorative properties, and you've trained from a young age to use them. No matter how few supplies may be available, you can make a small incision and use a tiny part of yourself to heal others. You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You can attempt a Medicine check to Administer First Aid or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds} without a medkit by losing 1 Hit Point. This damage can't be resisted, prevented, or negated in any way.
Arjan Healer Hardor.name: Arjan Healer Hardor

Artificial Scion Android.description: Your body wasn't created in the image of a biological creature; a powerful artificial intelligence created you to interface with other machines. Your physiology is nearly identical to other androids, but uncanny details give away your non-standard origins (for example, you might have impossibly symmetrical features, extra fingers, or double pupils). You become trained in Computers, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9]{Phreaker} skill feat.
Artificial Scion Android.name: Artificial Scion Android

Asanan Elf.description:
Your ancestors left the elven homeland for the jungles of Asana. Your family's deep and lasting bond to Castrovel's wild heart remains, but unlike the elves of Sovyrian, your connection to Asana's biome has unlocked a form of telepathy not unlike what your lashunta neighbors possess.

You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts and communicates no more information than normal speech would.
Asanan Elf.name: Asanan Elf

Ascendant Psychic Lashunta.description:
You're an ascendant psychic, a lashunta recognized as an exemplar in controlling your innate psychic magic.

Increase the range of your limited telepathy to 120 feet. If your class grants you spellcasting, innate spells you gain from an ancestry feat use the spellcasting tradition, key attribute modifier, spell attack modifier, and spell DC granted by your class.
Ascendant Psychic Lashunta.name: Ascendant Psychic Lashunta

Assimilated Astrazoan.description: Whether you were raised as a member of another species or became fully immersed in their cultures and traditions later, you have completely assimilated to another ancestry and feel as comfortable in that skin as in your natural form. Choose a common ancestry. You can select ancestry feats from the ancestry you chose, in addition to your character's own ancestry. You can select feats that require a physiological feature that you lack but can only benefit from those feats while you are in that ancestry's form; for example, an assimilated astrazoan who selects the shirren @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YSi48yghu0wmkSrr]{Basic Insectile Flight} feat can only fly while in their shirren form.
Assimilated Astrazoan.name: Assimilated Astrazoan

Assimilating Nuar.description: Your ability to blend with the many other species of the Pact Worlds has led you to attain the talents of the people around you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} general feat. You also gain one of that ancestry's native languages as a bonus language (such as Akitonian or Ysoki if you chose the ysoki ancestry).
Assimilating Nuar.name: Assimilating Nuar

Asteroid Hopper Sarcesian.description: Whether flitting between asteroids in the Diaspora or repairing the outer hull of a starship, you spend a lot of time in the void of space and have pushed yourself to stay exposed just a little longer every time you head out. You can remain in a vacuum much longer than the average sarcesian. You can maintain suspended respiration up to a maximum of 4 hours at a time, rather than 1 hour at a time.
Asteroid Hopper Sarcesian.name: Asteroid Hopper Sarcesian

Azrinaran Elf.description:
You're an azrinaran elf from the small, metal planetoid of Apostae. For generations, your family has lived divorced from the spiritual connection between an elf and a planet's natural environments, and even if you moved, future generations might never be able to forge a connection like that again.

You're accustomed to the darkness of Apostae's synthetic crags and caverns and gain darkvision.
Azrinaran Elf.name: Azrinaran Elf

Bioluminescent Brenneri.description:
You are descended from members of a community that lives in a network of sea caves where the sun doesn't reach, known as the Jobuwa Chasms. Other life in these caves, such as the winged murzzilats, barrel through the tight spaces at incredible speed. Injury from unintended collisions is so common that many beings who live in the chasms have evolved to emit light as a warning.

Your fur is made up of specialized fibers that absorb light from fluorescent algae. You can make your fur glow with bioluminescence or pat it down to stop glowing with an Interact action. When you glow, you shed bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

You are not @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while in water, and you don't take the usual penalties for using a bludgeoning or slashing melee weapon in water, or to ranged attacks made underwater or against an underwater enemy.
Bioluminescent Brenneri.name: Bioluminescent Brenneri

Biotech Android.description:
Plant grafts, living organs, and alien parts supplement the synthetic parts of your body. You might have been built for espionage, designed as a devastating biotech weapon, or created to coexist with nature.

You don't gain the attribute flaw to Charisma but instead gain a flaw to Constitution. You become trained in Nature and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.nowEaHgIyij7im8F]{Train Animal} skill feat.
Biotech Android.name: Biotech Android

Black Hole Novian.description:
Your progenitor star collapsed into a black hole, as have you. You don't shed light, and you lose the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.GSBkiEHvnSidFxvz]{Solar Luminance} ability.

You gain darkvision and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JdLNIaTM4eyI9Luo]{Absorb Light} action.
Black Hole Novian.name: Black Hole Novian

Bloodfilter Orocoran.description: Your blood filters dangerous chemicals and toxins directly from your bloodstream, enabling you to stave off afflictions and recover quickly from illness. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.N8Xz5fuW6o7GW124]{Fast Recovery} general feat and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.L0MLZNUoJ6lTlBZu]{Siphon Poison} ability.
Bloodfilter Orocoran.name: Bloodfilter Orocoran

Bloom-Born Kalo.description: You grew up near a bloom, one of the naturally occurring portals to the First World that randomly open and close across Kalo-Mahoi, and have developed a natural sense for the presence of primal magic around you. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. Additionally, you can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Bloom-Born Kalo.name: Bloom-Born Kalo

Borai.description: You've returned from the brink of death as a borai—at once both living and undead. You gain the borai and undead trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. Unlike other undead, you don't gain void healing. You're healed by vitality effects and damaged by void damage, as if you were a living creature. Likewise, you can be stabilized, healed, and brought back to life as if you were a living creature, save that you always return to life in your normal undead state (as a borai). You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from borai feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
Borai.name: Borai

Bouncy Orb Bantrid.description: Your diet has resulted in a foot orb surrounded in a layer of bouncy material, like a big rubber ball. You take no fall damage, regardless of the distance you fall.
Bouncy Orb Bantrid.name: Bouncy Orb Bantrid

Bright Novian.description:
You're brilliant, blazing with a light that puts other novians to shame.

You shed bright light in a 60-foot radius, rather than a 20-foot radius, and dim light for the next 60 feet, rather than the next 20 feet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.K37N5t6v7kgImnDN]{Concentrate Light} action.
Bright Novian.name: Bright Novian

Brightsheen G'folian.description: A layer of scintillating patterns shifts across your shell like a kaleidoscopic oil slick. This quality comes from a ditty history of constant travel during daytime hours under the sun of your home world. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.e2lugcxHnxTkQeMc]{Dazzling Shell} reaction.
Brightsheen G'folian.name: Brightsheen G'folian

Brilliant Mien Ijtikri.description:
Whether due to its micaceous inclusions, crystalline structure, or reflective hue, your mantle shimmers resplendently in the light. You've learned how to awe others with its beauty.

You're trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. While in bright light, you can [[/act demoralize]] by redirecting light at your foes. When you do, Demoralize loses the auditory trait and gains the visual trait, and you don't take a penalty if the creature doesn't understand your language. If you have another ability that lets you ignore the penalty for not sharing a language (such as the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat) and are in normal or bright light, you instead increase the range of Demoralize to 40 feet.
Brilliant Mien Ijtikri.name: Brilliant Mien Ijtikri

Briskwander Vesk.description: You come from a line of vesk who were constantly on the move. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Briskwander Vesk.name: Briskwander Vesk

Builder Formian.description:
You're an architect and builder, drawing upon the vast knowledge of your colony for your craft. You can comfortably form structures out of whatever material the environment is made of, such as dirt, stone, or wood, but might have also learned from other societies and their building techniques and materials to innovate upon formian architecture.

As a builder formian, you become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (such as from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also have a burrow Speed of 5 feet. If you take the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.kxqA0WIJbfwZzvHS]{Burrowing Specialist} feat, your burrow Speed increases to 20 feet.
Builder Formian.name: Builder Formian

Bulky Nuar.description: Even among tall and heavy species, you're considered a giant bruiser. Your size is Large instead of Medium. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to [[/act shove]] or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to move you or knock you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
Bulky Nuar.name: Bulky Nuar

Bumalla Worlanisi.description:
Your home world has become a hub of tourism as people come from all over to witness Worlan's famed competitions or try their luck against the luckiest people in the galaxy. You might work at the Short Straw, where the customer always loses, in one of the countless theaters and arenas in Nasceri, Worlan's capital city, or at any number of similar venues across the stars. Perhaps you've raced across the entire planet in Fortune's Regatta, smiling for the camera and striking dramatic poses as you dashed through storms and over mountains.

No matter where you are, you can always find an audience, and though keeping the people happy is hard work, you've paid your dues. You know how to earn that applause, and thanks to the experience, you've come away with a potentially handy set of skills. You're trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.lFwfUvH2708rl6i3]{Virtuosic Performer} skill feat.
Bumalla Worlanisi.name: Bumalla Worlanisi

Burrow-Sworn Vulkarisu.description: You are a short-tailed vulkarisu with a body adapted to live in underground burrows deeper than most. Burrow-sworn believe all life arose from the planet, and the deeper you travel, the longer and more prosperous your life. Even in urban environments, most burrow-sworn prefer working and living underground, more comfortable in cozy hovels than the soulless glass skyscrapers they call "Shivaska's sky-prisons." You gain darkvision and a burrow Speed of 10 feet. You do not gain a climb Speed or Land on Your Feet.
Burrow-Sworn Vulkarisu.name: Burrow-Sworn Vulkarisu

Canopy Crawler Osharu.description:
Isolated research communities dot Jenikar's jungles, populated by botanists, zoologists, and biologists. Those who live in the depths of the sodden rain forests contend daily with camouflaging ambush predators, hypnotic carnivorous plants, and swarms of telepathic amphibious rodents. Osharus from the jungle are lanky and lean, with adhesive secretions and clinging cilia that make them natural climbers.

You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.vwX3DQxsk04bTCBq]{Climbing Specialist} (25 feet) feat.
Canopy Crawler Osharu.name: Canopy Crawler Osharu

Caravan Cousin Halfling.description:
You spent a significant portion of your life traveling with a halfling caravan, wheeling and dealing with people from all kinds of worlds, social strata, and moral inclinations.

You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.5nc5ridFBfYpn2Om]{Bargain Hunter} feat and a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}.
Caravan Cousin Halfling.name: Caravan Cousin Halfling

Cataclyst Human.description:
You're the child of a dead world or doomed civilization, a lost offshoot of humanity that perished due to invasion, natural disaster, or war. You've grown cautious and learned from your people's shattered past, determined to break destructive patterns and reclaim your place in the galaxy.

The circumstance bonus to initiative rolls you gain when you or an ally uses the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity is +2 instead of +1. When you roll initiative, you can Stand or Step as a reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.YdijKJgLnRTNQR7v]{Effect: Scout (Cataclyst Human)}
Cataclyst Human.name: Cataclyst Human

Chemoreceptive Gnarefuroid.description: Gnarefuroids from habitats tainted by dangerous chemical runoff develop highly sensitive taste cirrisensors. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against effects with the ingested or olfactory trait; if you roll a success on a saving throw against such an effect, you critically succeed instead.
Chemoreceptive Gnarefuroid.name: Chemoreceptive Gnarefuroid

Citadel Dwarf.description: You're part of a renowned mining clan that tunnels into planets, moons, and asteroids for rare minerals. You become trained in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. When you critically succeed at a Survival check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income} by mining, you uncover a vein of highly valuable minerals. The next time you use Survival to Earn Income in the same location, you treat the task level as 1 higher. If you're a master in Survival, you treat the task level as 2 higher, and if you're legendary in Survival, you treat the task level as 4 higher. The DC for the task remains the same.
Citadel Dwarf.name: Citadel Dwarf

City Kin Copaxi.description:
You're from one of Tabrid Minor's many sprawling megacities. These environments are where most copaxis live for their entire lives. Like the polyps that form their bodies, each copaxi plays a specific role in their society. Due to governmental oversight and strict regulations, most city kin copaxis don't adapt to new roles more than once or twice over the course of their entire lives, despite their ability to dramatically change nearly every facet of their body and self over time.

City kin typically take work in Tabrid Minor's many factories, mines, and agro-industrial facilities, where group effort is emphasized more than individual contributions. As a city kin, you're accustomed to a crowded life of hard, collaborative work in an urban environment. You become trained in a Lore skill associated with your profession, such as Cooking Lore. If you would automatically become trained in that Lore (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a more specific Lore associated with your skill (such as Knife Lore for a chef). You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression]] or Request something from someone in your profession.
City Kin Copaxi.name: City Kin Copaxi

Citywrought G'folian.description: Where most g'folian ditties were isolationists, your forebears lived in urban areas. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.49lDxXmZZ0eJFI78]{Blend In} skill feat.
Citywrought G'folian.name: Citywrought G'folian

Clan Kindred Orc.description:
The belief that your ancestors walk with Torag among the stars holds a personal meaning for you. Raised among dwarves, you're a symbol of all that's been lost but also all that's been built anew. Dwarves have taught you all your life, taking you in just as they would any other member of the clan, while also recognizing your importance to their shared culture with orcs.

You gain the Dwarven Lore feat, learn Dwarven as an additional language, and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.cZyhFXHxnmtK0hlY]{Clan Crystal} dwarven ancestry feature. In addition, when you gain an ancestry feat, you can choose from dwarf and orc feats in addition to those from other sources.
Clan Kindred Orc.name: Clan Kindred Orc

Clawed Brenneri.description:
You are a particularly muscular brenneri with pronounced claws, standing out as a potential defender or soldier among your pod. You can pry open oysters or crabs with ease, and your claws are robust enough to serve as a natural defense.

Additionally, you become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Athletics checks to [[/act force-open]], and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RdWNYoypgL5dMO0a]{Ancestral Unarmed Attack} (claw, 1d6 slashing [agile, finesse, unarmed], brawling weapon group) ancestry feat.
Clawed Brenneri.name: Clawed Brenneri

Clinging Gnarefuroid.description: Gnarefuroids accustomed to turbulent environments overproduce adhesive resin and develop appendages capable of powerful suction. Improve your climb Speed to 20 feet. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} skill feat.
Clinging Gnarefuroid.name: Clinging Gnarefuroid

Cloned Astrazoan.description: You were either born in a laboratory using genetic samples preserved from a distant ancestor or budded from a parent astrazoan. Your body stubbornly refuses additional external attempts to change you. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a curse, disease, or polymorph effect, you get a critical success instead.
Cloned Astrazoan.name: Cloned Astrazoan

Code-Sworn Vulkarisu.description: Your family descends from vulkarisu who first decoded Triune's Signal and spread the knowledge of Drift travel across Castrovel. Strange markings on your fur in a hodgepodge of cryptogram-like markings are both the source of your personal name and are said to be a portion of the code that underlies the universe. You gain one cantrip from the arcane spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an innate arcane spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Replace all instances of "primal" or "Nature" in all vulkarisu ancestry feats you gain with "arcane" and "Arcana" respectively, including the tradition of all innate spells you gain, the traits of the feats, and the feats' prerequisites.
Code-Sworn Vulkarisu.name: Code-Sworn Vulkarisu

Community-Sworn Vulkarisu.description: You're an enthusiastic traveler, adopting innovative ideas, traditions, and words from the cultures you've visited and integrating them into your life. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain your choice of either the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} general feat or the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} skill feat.
Community-Sworn Vulkarisu.name: Community-Sworn Vulkarisu

Compact Sarcesian.description: You're incredibly flexible and can fold your gangly limbs up and around yourself like a contortionist, enabling you to maneuver in small and awkward spaces. You can fit through tight spaces as though you were a Medium creature.
Compact Sarcesian.name: Compact Sarcesian

Construct Copycat.description: You have reinforced your body with technological augmentations that can be shifted to give yourself the appearance of a constructed creature. You can use Change Shape to assume the appearance of a Small or Medium construct. You gain the Augmented Body general feat.
Construct Copycat.name: Construct Copycat

Contract-Sworn Vulkarisu.description: You were born to a family under contract with Shivaska's divine herald Skew. Whether you worship or resent the demon lord is up to you, but you know eventually you or your descendants will be called to fulfill your end of a fiendish contract, and you've picked up some skills hoping to minimize the costs, or perhaps even come out ahead. You are trained in Deception. If you would automatically become trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Dvz54d6aPhjsmUux]{Lie to Me} skill feat, and can apply the benefits of the feat when looking for lies, loopholes, or other deceptions in the terms of a contract or deal, even if the deal doesn't involve a back-and-forth conversation.
Contract-Sworn Vulkarisu.name: Contract-Sworn Vulkarisu

Corpsefolk.description:
Corpsefolk are people who died and reanimated as corporeal, intelligent undead, with the same general appearance and personality they had in life, though usually with sickly pale skin, rotting parts, exposed bone, or other signs of putrescence.

You are a reanimated corpse. Your undead nature might physically manifest in gray or pale skin, eyes that turn solid black or white, or an unnatural elongation of the fingernails (or similar appendages). You gain the corpsefolk and undead traits, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from corpsefolk feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.

Corpsefolk also gain the following.

Immunity to Death Effects: You are immune to death effects, such as being automatically killed or having your dying value increase, but not other parts of the spell or effect (such as damage or becoming frightened from vision of death).

Void Healing: You are damaged by vitality damage and aren't healed by vitality healing effects. You don't take void damage and are healed by void effects that heal undead.

Void Survival: Unlike normal undead, you aren't destroyed when reduced to 0 Hit Points. Instead, powerful energies attempt to keep you from being destroyed. You are knocked out and begin dying when reduced to 0 Hit Points. Because you're undead, many methods of bringing someone back from the dying condition, such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SnjhtQYexDtNDdEg]{Stabilize}, don't benefit you. When you would die, you're destroyed rather than just dead, just like other undead.

Special: At the GM's discretion, you can select the corpsefolk versatile heritage after 1st level if your character dies and has an opportunity to be raised as an undead. This replaces your heritage.
Corpsefolk.name: Corpsefolk

Cosmopolitan Atraxid.description: You grew up around a wide variety of species. Zulphan is the most populous planet in the Szandite Collective and correspondingly has the most visitors from elsewhere in the Collective and beyond. You know one additional language from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} skill feat.
Cosmopolitan Atraxid.name: Cosmopolitan Atraxid

Countershade Crest Ijtikri.description:
Your mantle's coloration is palest on your ventral side and darkest on your dorsal "face." While it provides a nominal advantage at remaining undetected in water, the pattern often accompanies a streamlined body with exceptional buoyancy control, enabling you to swim swiftly.

Your swim Speed increases to 20 feet, and you gain the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.
Countershade Crest Ijtikri.name: Countershade Crest Ijtikri

Court of Dance Moyishuu.description:
Your nature is expressed primarily by movement, and you can seem aloof to many outsiders as you focus more on your movements than on those around you.

You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.lqdeHNRyaa2EfXXG]{Crowd Surfing} skill feat. Additionally, once per day, you can temporarily attune your soulfeel to joy for 1 minute as a free action that has the concentrate trait.
Court of Dance Moyishuu.name: Court of Dance Moyishuu

Court of Fields Moyishuu.description:
Your nature is to enact plans, whether they're immediate paths to your goal or years-long pursuits.

You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} skill feat. Additionally, once per day, you can temporarily attune your soulfeel to wonder for 1 minute as a free action that has the concentrate trait.
Court of Fields Moyishuu.name: Court of Fields Moyishuu

Court of Flames Moyishuu.description:
Your nature is to tackle your problems immediately and directly, even if it means leaving scorched earth in your wake.

You become trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ar2DUlvDK4LDcH9J]{Quick Coercion} skill feat. Additionally, once per day, you can temporarily attune your soulfeel to fury for 1 minute as a free action that has the concentrate trait.
Court of Flames Moyishuu.name: Court of Flames Moyishuu

Court of Song Moyishuu.description:
Your nature is passionately artistic, and you have an intrinsic connection to the expression of that ability.

You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} skill feat. Additionally, once per day, you can temporarily attune your soulfeel to sorrow for 1 minute as a free action that has the concentrate trait.
Court of Song Moyishuu.name: Court of Song Moyishuu

Courtier Shirren.description: Your telepathy is stronger than most shirrens', allowing you to combine physical, verbal, and telepathic communication. You can transmit emotions alongside your messages whenever you use limited telepathy. In addition, when a creature communicates with you using limited telepathy or telepathy, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive} against that creature.
Courtier Shirren.name: Courtier Shirren

Covert Observer Barathu.description:
You wish to learn about others but are concerned that your mere presence might affect how they live and act. Rather than directly engaging with other cultures or wildlife, you prefer to unobtrusively observe them. You can modify the shape of your body as well as genetically modify its composition to blend in with the natural surroundings of those you seek to observer.

You become trained in Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in Stealth (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.pekKtubQTkG9m1xK]{Quiet Allies} skill feat (even if you don't meet the feat's prerequisites). You can spend 10 minutes modifying the shape and color of your body to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth while using the [[/act avoid-notice]] exploration activity in that environment (this bonus applies to initiative rolls with Stealth if you're Avoiding Notice at the start of an encounter).
Covert Observer Barathu.name: Covert Observer Barathu

Crystal Carapace Urog.description:
Your crystalline husk is thicker than most, and you've situated your shell in a fashion that grants additional physical protection.

Your shell counts as light armor in the ceramic armor group that grants a +2 item bonus to AC, a Dex Cap of +2, a check penalty of –1, and has the archaic, comfort, and flexible traits. The resistance granted by Armor Specialization is electricity. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit}, but you can't wear other armor. You can't install armor upgrades. You gain the trained proficiency rank in this armor.
Crystal Carapace Urog.name: Crystal Carapace Urog

Crystal Crown Ijtikri.description:
When your mantle grew and hardened, it incorporated distinctive minerals that forever linked you to the environs. These crystals most often grow in a crown-like pattern above your uppermost eyes. Something about the crystals resonate with their native environment, giving you an intuitive sense for the terrain and its fauna.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for a Lore skill related to the terrain where your mantle formed (such as Ocean Lore or Forest Lore). You can also ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals native to that terrain (as determined by the GM).
Crystal Crown Ijtikri.name: Crystal Crown Ijtikri

Crèche-Raised Sarcesian.description: You were raised on an idyllic crèche world and lived closely with dozens of other sarcesian children. You learned how to get along with others and stand out in a crowd early on. You are trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} skill feat.
Crèche-Raised Sarcesian.name: Crèche-Raised Sarcesian

Damai Human.description:
The ancestors of damai humans survived an apocalypse that unleashed monstrous kaiju on Daimalko, their home world in Near Space. After years of sheltering underground, your people have finally begun reclaiming the surface with the help of allies from other worlds. Many damais born since the Awakening cataclysm have gray skin and bright, piercing eyes. In the past, damais had a variety of skin tones in deep terra-cotta shades. Mechs, called valkos, are an important part of your culture. Surface cities are protected by huzkars, brave warriors who pilot valkos in battle against colossal threats. Some damais still live underground in protected shelters, and others have fled their apparently doomed home world for other horizons, often taking their family mechs with them.

You're trained in Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in Piloting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain limited telepathy, meaning you can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
Damai Human.name: Damai Human

Damaya Lashunta.description:
You've chosen the adaptive genetics to become a damaya. You might have a leaner, lither body type than other lashuntas and are likely encouraged to pursue work as a scholar or politician.

In addition to what you gain from your ancestry, you gain an attribute boost to Intelligence and an attribute flaw to Constitution, but the free ancestry boost can't also be Intelligence. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat.
Damaya Lashunta.name: Damaya Lashunta

Deadwood.description: You've been rotting on the inside for some time now, and the invisible rot has changed you. You have the void healing ability, meaning you're damaged by vitality damage and not healed by healing vitality effects. You do not take void damage, and you're healed by void effects that heal undead.
Deadwood.name: Deadwood

Deep Kalo.description: You were born deep down in the aphotic zone where no light penetrates from the surface, far from the bright cities clustered around Kalo-Mahoi's geothermal oases, You gain echolocation as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet, or 60 feet when underwater.
Deep Kalo.name: Deep Kalo

Deep Space Hryngar.description:
You're a hryngar, one of the subterranean dwarves of Golarion's Darklands who rejected the Quest for Sky. Droskar, the outcast god of toil and tyranny, forged your ancestors' society into cruel hierarchies. Today, some hryngars honor Droskar by participating in a variety of schemes, from casinos to repo operations, along with shady professions such as cryptobroker and loan shark.

You have an attribute bonus to Charisma and a flaw to Wisdom rather than the other way around (unless you choose two free attribute boosts instead of the usual boosts and flaw). You become trained in Deception. If you would automatically become trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. If a creature owes you money or has caused you significant financial loss, you have a +1 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to Lie to them, to Perception DCs against attempts to Lie to you, and to Intimidation checks to [[/act coerce]] or [[/act demoralize]] them.
Deep Space Hryngar.name: Deep Space Hryngar

Deep Ysoki.description: You're accustomed to living in dark places, such as maintenance shafts, asteroids, and on distant moons and planetoids far from the sun. You gain darkvision.
Deep Ysoki.name: Deep Ysoki

Deepmarsh Osharu.description:
Deepmarsh osharus are highly solitary, forsaking the comforts, luxuries, and benefits of society to seek the ascetic wisdom and challenges of the deepest swamps. Novel pathogens and venomous fauna are near-daily occurrences in the primordial breeding ground of the fetid mire, and surviving takes knowledge of the common dangers.

You become trained in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Deepmarsh Osharu.name: Deepmarsh Osharu

Defiant Shirren.description: Despite the passage of time, you remain resolute in your defiance of the Swarm and all forms of mental control. If you roll a success on a Will saving throw against an effect that was created by a creature with the kucharn trait or a creature that you know is allied with the Swarm, you get a critical success instead. You gain these benefits against any creature affected by a spell or effect that controls it. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.nAJeT29ZJvqeg98h]{Rebellious Defiance} action.
Defiant Shirren.name: Defiant Shirren

Dense Novian.description:
Whether you were born from an explosive supernova or brilliant nebula, your progenitor star remains out there to this day, burning bright as a superdense neutron star or a white dwarf. Like your progenitor, you're incredibly dense, weighing twice as much as a typical novian. You're capable of standing firm against the strongest of external forces and enduring any hardship.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to force you to move or knock you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. In addition, if any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you're moved only half the distance.
Dense Novian.name: Dense Novian

Desert Ikeshti.description:
You're accustomed to surviving in the harsh, arid deserts of Akiton, and can endure the blazing heat of the midday sun.

You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and environmental heat effects are one step less extreme for you (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on). In addition, increase the number of days you can go without food or water before you begin to starve by 1 month.
Desert Ikeshti.name: Desert Ikeshti

Doomsayer Kasatha.description:
You're the scion of a Great Family that stayed behind to minister final rites to the dying planet. Safe in a ship or satellite, viewing the tiny planet silhouetted against the great red giant destined to one day devour it, you have a unique perspective on doom. Constantly, gently encroaching, it's neither something to be feared nor something to be looked forward to, and you've learned techniques for both staving it off and for embracing it.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.CPO4LgkZPHIHQEB4]{Doomsayer's Litany} reaction.
Doomsayer Kasatha.name: Doomsayer Kasatha

Dreamer Barathu.description:
You've communed with the cosmic melody of Liavara and it changed you. You struggle to express the fragments of memory and sensation you recall from the experience, except through singing and similar psychic emanations. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. By weaving magic into your song, you can cast this spell as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.

Your magic is adaptable, and you can channel your music to enhance it. Once per day, you can meditate on your cosmic song to change the cantrip you've chosen to a different cantrip from the occult spell list. This is a 10-minute activity that has the concentrate trait.
Dreamer Barathu.name: Dreamer Barathu

Drift Delver Gnome.description:
While many of your kin still feel the call of the First World, you're drawn to a much newer source of curiosity: the Drift, the artificial plane created by Triune. Your hair shines and sparkles with the phantasmagoric colors of the Machine God's plane. Whether you're a devotee of Triune with a supernatural sense of the plane or a veteran pilot with months of travel logged there, you're at home flying around the chaotic dimension.

You become trained in Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in Piloting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.hsUKPqTdAvWwsqH2]{Navigate} within or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.LXqcXRayK58inaKo]{Plot Course} through the Drift, and you reduce the travel time it takes to fly to a destination in or through the Drift by 1 day.
Drift Delver Gnome.name: Drift Delver Gnome

Ductsneak Halfling.description:
You have taken to subsisting in the forgotten grooves of society, living in the hidden nooks and crannies of settlements, starships, and far stranger places. You're comfortable living on the edges of society and are no stranger to finding shelter in a pinch.

You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} skill feat. Additionally, you don't take a penalty for not using a crowbar to [[/act force-open]] a panel, grate, or similar impediment to enter a space that a Medium creature would need to squeeze inside to enter.
Ductsneak Halfling.name: Ductsneak Halfling

Early Stage Barathu.description: You're young and inexperienced compared to other barathus, with an individualistic worldview likely shaped by your interactions with other cultures. You have yet to see the full breadth of the cosmos and haven't adapted yourself to overcome its many threats or understand its various life-forms. Your form is highly mutable, as you haven't yet chosen to specialize or merge with other barathus. You're Small instead of Medium. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.3G8xUlgCjRmRJNfP]{Quick Squeeze} as a bonus feat. Additionally, you gain resistance to precision damage equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Early Stage Barathu.name: Early Stage Barathu

Electric Kalo.description:
You descend from a remote tribe in Kalo-Mahoi's photic zone that developed a bioelectric defense against predators, perhaps due to the influence of a bloom or because of an ancient diet of electric rays. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.kBhaPuzLUSwS6vVf]{Electric Arc} cantrip as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. If you cast this spell with only 1 target, you gain electricity resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feat-effects.Item.xQvyfiOh05xK2A5A]{Effect: Electric Kalo}
Electric Kalo.name: Electric Kalo

Electronica Android.description:
Your body was first created to perform live music for the wealthy or help composers with their work. You were intended to play what you were given, to the exact specifications on the sheet music. However, the music you and your predecessors have played over the years has awakened a profound creative spirit within you. You're an electronica android, expressly designed to be exceptional at playing music and communicating complex emotions through sounds.

You gain an attribute boost to Charisma instead of Intelligence and an attribute flaw to Wisdom instead of Charisma. You're trained in Performance.

When you use an action with the linguistic trait, you can attempt to communicate using music instead of language, losing the linguistic trait and gaining the emotion trait if the action didn't already have that trait. You can only convey simple feelings or responses when communicating in this way.
Electronica Android.name: Electronica Android

Elusive Mecenaic.description: Some mecenaic settlements are in areas with unusually high populations of predators, even for Xofirth. Like many other mecenaics in those areas, you had to rely on your elusive instincts during your formative life stage. Those instincts have stuck with you all your life. You can use your shell to [[/act hide]] without any cover or concealment from creatures that don't realize you're alive. If you succeed, onlookers still see you, but they mistake you for an inanimate shell. After being fooled once, they realize you're alive, and you can't Hide from them in that way again.
Elusive Mecenaic.name: Elusive Mecenaic

Emeritus Trox.description:
You've gone through the Leaving and taken on a new name upon deciding to change your life, either by leaving your home to traverse the stars or by taking on a new role and challenge in your community. Though you've left your old life behind, you carry decades of expertise with you.

You're trained in a skill of your choice that has the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action. When you attempt a check in a Lore skill you're untrained in, treat your level as your proficiency bonus.
Emeritus Trox.name: Emeritus Trox

Empathic Vlaka.description: You instinctively sense when the people around you are feeling strong emotions or inner conflict. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1xRFPTFtWtGJ9ELw]{Sense Motive}. If you aren't actively using Sense Motive on a creature who's enchanted, possessed, or subject to an emotion effect, the GM rolls a secret check, without the usual circumstance bonus and with a –2 circumstance penalty, for you to potentially notice the enchantment, possession, or emotion effect anyway.
Empathic Vlaka.name: Empathic Vlaka

Enhoitra Maraquoi.description: You're from the shores of Marata and able to dart through the water as fast as you walk on land. Your aptitude at swimming is apparent, but you can quickly translate that skill into operating in zero-gravity environments. Your claws are duller and shorter than maraquois who climb, but you have tough webbing between your fingers and toes. You don't feel disoriented while floating in the water or in space. You don't have a climb Speed. You gain a swim Speed of 25 feet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.aJUXbe9HJVvv0Mxa]{Breath Control} general feat and aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while in water or zero gravity.
Enhoitra Maraquoi.name: Enhoitra Maraquoi

Enshrined Vesk.description:
You're the soul of a dead vesk hero preserved—or trapped—inside a living stone statue sculpted in your likeness.

You gain the construct trait. You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe. You always have basic environmental protections. You don't need to sleep, but you still need a daily period of rest. During this period of rest, you must enter a meditative conclave with your assembly of souls for 2 hours, which is similar to sleeping as you're still unaware of your surroundings, but you don't take any other penalties for being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. Much like with sleeping, if you go too long without entering your meditative state, you become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} and can't recover until you enter your meditative state for 2 hours.
Enshrined Vesk.name: Enshrined Vesk

Entertainer Elebrian.description: You love being in the spotlight, and you've spent a good deal of your life on camera. You were born and raised in the Halls of the Living, where you learned how to entertain an audience from childhood. You might be a rising superstar or a prominent character actor, extra, or reality show contestant with a growing fan following. You're trained in Performance and Media Lore, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xqAdXRd2gSQcqp5E]{Impressive Performance} skill feat.
Entertainer Elebrian.name: Entertainer Elebrian

Everwhelp Skittermander.description: Despite being a full-grown adult, you've retained your stomach-mouth—either through a quirk of evolution, purposeful genetic manipulation, or a biotech augmentation. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the finesse, skittermander, and unarmed traits.
Everwhelp Skittermander.name: Everwhelp Skittermander

Exiled Elebrian.description: You're a rarity: an elebrian who wasn't born on Eox. Perhaps your parents left the Halls of the Living before you were born to give you a better life. Maybe you come from a tiny enclave of elebrians making their home away from Eox, a tight-knit community on Absalom Station, or an asteroid in the Diaspora. You learn any regional language of your choice and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for that region. You learn another regional language and gain the Additional Lore general feat for that region at 5th level, and again at 13th level.
Exiled Elebrian.name: Exiled Elebrian

Experimental Ikeshti.description:
Scientists have experimented on you, and whether you were paid for your services or were captured as a hatchling and raised in a lab, this experimentation has left a lasting mark.

Increase your augmentation implant limit by 1; this additional augmentation can only be implanted with biotech augmentations. Choose one common biotech augmentation with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this biotech augmentation already implanted in your body. You don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting augmentation. You can remove and replace this augmentation following the usual rules.
Experimental Ikeshti.name: Experimental Ikeshti

Expertise and More Expertise Phasorq.description: Your two heads hardly ever agree on what to wear, where to go, nor what skills to learn. You've certainly found your main specialty by now, but that doesn't mean your other head has given up dabbling in something else entirely. During your daily preparations, you can focus your dabbling on a particular subject to become trained in one Lore skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until your next daily preparations. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.
Expertise and More Expertise Phasorq.name: Expertise and More Expertise Phasorq

Faith Converted Urog.description:
You believe the best way to learn the about the universe is to go to the gods who created it. Your research has most likely led you away from Dykon to spiritual mentors, with the hopes of learning directly from the gods themselves.

You become trained in Religion (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Religion) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.x7EMZNMavris2aHY]{Student of the Canon} feat. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell}.
Faith Converted Urog.name: Faith Converted Urog

Fanged Binnaquid.description: Your teeth are particularly sharp, and you may hunt as your ancestors did: lying in wait underwater until something draws close enough for you to attack and bite. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the binnaquid, finesse, and unarmed traits.
Fanged Binnaquid.name: Fanged Binnaquid

Fidgeter Skittermander.description:
You've never been able to sit still, which helps you avoid danger during tricky situations. Your background might include a specific quirk you can't stop doing or a need to pace around during even the most serious moments. Some might find you off-putting or annoying, but most have come to accept you for who you are.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.gS62Drm7DuTrc9Y3]{Fidget} reaction.
Fidgeter Skittermander.name: Fidgeter Skittermander

Field Researcher Urog.description:
Your studies have taken you out of the comfort of your domicile. Fortunately, your unique biology provides you with the perfect means to surviving the harshest environments.

You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} in any atmospheric environment. You're never @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} or at risk of dying from a lack of food regardless of your result.

In addition, your silicon biology allows you to survive in inhospitable temperatures. Environmental effects are one step less extreme for you (incredible becomes extreme, extreme becomes severe, and so on).
Field Researcher Urog.name: Field Researcher Urog

Fierce Ysoki.description: You're a fierce ysoki, built differently from others with a bulkier body and sharp teeth. You gain an attribute boost to Strength instead of Dexterity and an attribute flaw to Dexterity instead of Strength. You gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. Your jaws unarmed attack deals 1d8 piercing, is in the brawling group, and has the grapple and unarmed traits instead.
Fierce Ysoki.name: Fierce Ysoki

Fire Flood Fonqugon.description:
Rodnarth's rivers sometimes become infested with a rapidly blooming algae that has an especially destructive life cycle. When the algae colony dies, it produces a chemical compound that turns the river water into a fiery liquid, also expanding its volume with sudden intensity. This causes a sort of flash flood that incinerates everything in its wake and threatens to cascade into other wildfires during dry weather.

As a fire flood fonqugon, you're especially hardy, just like the fonqon tree that survived a fire flood before birthing you. You gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6, and you gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Fire Flood Fonqugon.name: Fire Flood Fonqugon

Flameheart Dragonkin.description: The embers burning in your blood keep you safe from the chill of high altitudes. You gain resistance to cold equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
Flameheart Dragonkin.name: Flameheart Dragonkin

Fluffy Skittermander.description:
Your long, fast-growing fur can be groomed to cool or insulate your body.

Your winter coat gives you cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).

Your summer coat gives you fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1), and you treat all environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme.

You can shed or grow a new coat as part of your daily preparations.
Fluffy Skittermander.name: Fluffy Skittermander

Fork-tongued Vesk.description:
Fork-tongued vesk of the Gojori swamps turn their saliva into potent venom by ingesting a toxic cocktail of swamp water mixed with poisonous plants and insects. Traveling to new worlds has further developed this already lethal venom by broadening the scope of new ingredients added to their dangerous diets. No two forked-tongued vesk have exactly the same saliva composition.

You have a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against disease and poison. You're immune to the poison damage caused by the jaws attack of fork-tongued vesk. You gain a venomous jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d4 poison damage and has the grapple and unarmed traits. On a critical hit, the target takes persistent poison damage equal to the number of weapon damage dice. This attack doesn't have a weapon group or critical specialization effect.
Fork-tongued Vesk.name: Fork-tongued Vesk

Fortified Trox.description:
You bathed in the waters of Gabanon Springs during a molting period. Extra nutrition from the spring's waters soaked into the soft tissues, doing wonders for its composition. Your exoskeleton might look more stonelike than most of your kind, or it might have taken on a gemlike sheen as the membranes grow denser than is normally possible.

Your chitinous plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +4 item bonus to AC, with a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and have the analog, comfort, and exposed traits. You're trained in your chitinous plates. You can wear a flight suit over your exoskeleton, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your chitinous plates, but you can't install armor upgrades.
Fortified Trox.name: Fortified Trox

Fortunaut Worlanisi.description:
Life is the journey—your journey is your life. You've taken to the stars to travel the galaxy, and thanks to your good luck, many ships gladly take you aboard as a welcome fortunaut, a sentient good luck charm. A wandering fortunaut in search of work is never unemployed for long.

It's no secret that having one of the luckiest people in the galaxy around can be good for business, and you've learned how to use that to your advantage when you find yourself somewhere new. You're trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.4RjDxgvNXNl5GG9d]{Hobnobber} skill feat.
Fortunaut Worlanisi.name: Fortunaut Worlanisi

Frilled Vesk.description:
You can deploy colorful neck frills to intimidate your rivals and regulate your body temperature. The highest concentration of frilled vesk originate in the Vaaranas Desert of Vesk Prime, but similar mutations have been found on vesk stationed for generations in jungle and desert biomes.

You become trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat, allowing you to use your neck frill to [[/act demoralize]] your foes. You treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme head becomes severe, and so on).
Frilled Vesk.name: Frilled Vesk

Fullbright Shirren.description:
You were raised in one of the shirren colonies, and as a result, you're used to the sun never setting on your work. Having to manually retreat into the shadowed caverns to rest has made you accustomed to working harder on less sleep.

You only have to rest for 6 hours to gain the full benefit of an 8-hour rest. In addition, you're resistant to the effects of fatigue; you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.
Fullbright Shirren.name: Fullbright Shirren

Gadraveech Skittermander.description: You grew up in the subterranean realm of Gadraveech, or a similar dangerous underground environment. You have wispy, pale-colored fur, a slender build, and large, luminous eyes. You gain darkvision.
Gadraveech Skittermander.name: Gadraveech Skittermander

Galactic Wanderer Barathu.description:
The wonders of the universe called to you early in life, beckoning you to leave the confines of terrestrial spheres and travel the galaxy instead. As a young barathu, you spent much of your time exploring the vastness of space, seeking out celestial bodies and learning about the flora and fauna that had adapted to live within them.

You gain the cosmic trait, and in areas of zero gravity, your fly Speed increases by 10. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.nPn7rGTTao4cFYDr]{Living Capsule} action when in a zero-gravity environment.
Galactic Wanderer Barathu.name: Galactic Wanderer Barathu

Gallant Skittermander.description:
Not everyone feels safe sticking up for themself, but they know that you're someone they can lean on to help. Maybe you are the oldest of your siblings or just loved to spend your childhood getting into scraps. Perhaps you've found yourself bulking up by exercising daily at the gym. No matter how you come by it, your athletic prowess has found you often sticking up for others, especially other skittermanders, so frequently that it affected your growth. These continuously occurring conflicts have triggered a recessive trait, causing you to grow to twice the size of a standard skittermander.

You gain a bonus to Strength instead of Dexterity, are Medium sized, and are trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KxaYlC50zzHysJj8]{Titan Wrestler} skill feat.
Gallant Skittermander.name: Gallant Skittermander

Gap-Touched.description: The Gap has subsumed some part of you and left you with weird powers and jarring existential issues, while giving you a unique ability to perceive the history obscured by the Gap. You gain the Gap-touched trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. You can choose from Gap-touched feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} general feat for Gap Lore. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects.
Gap-Touched.name: Gap-Touched

Genetic Pioneer Lashunta.description:
As a genetic pioneer lashunta, auto-experimentation is your craft, and your body is your canvas. You increase the number of augmentations you can implant in your body by 2.

You become trained in Medicine. If you would automatically become trained in Medicine (such as from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. If you have master or legendary proficiency rank in Medicine, you can Implant your own Augmentations and reduce the time it takes to Implant Augmentation to 10 minutes per item level of the augmentation. For the purposes of prerequisites, you have the unbound lashunta heritage.
Genetic Pioneer Lashunta.name: Genetic Pioneer Lashunta

Genetically Unstable Barathu.description:
You've constantly adapted your form to learn more about the creatures and environment around you. While you've gained plenty of knowledge, it came with a price. Through decades of modification, the sequencing of your genetic code has broken down and become unstable. You're more transparent than most barathus, resembling an ooze-like creature.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.pO1wkgklxp9j1taY]{Become Ooze} action.
Genetically Unstable Barathu.name: Genetically Unstable Barathu

Gengen Osharu.description:
Gengen osharus adapted to the seawaters of Pabaq's briny seas and are credited for mapping the continents of Pabaq as they spread settlements along the coast. Among osharus, gengens are known for their daring, and many famous osharu explorers trace their origins to gengen communities. Gengens are amphibious and can survive indefinitely on land but find immersion in water to be relaxing, and thus they prefer working on aquatic or archipelagic planets for easy access to swimming.

You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet, and you gain the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.
Gengen Osharu.name: Gengen Osharu

Glacierborn Shobhad.description: You trace your lineage to a shobhad clan that migrates along the Akitonian glaciers, making you even more advantageously suited to dealing with the dangers of frigid cold and treacherous climbs than other shobhads. You have cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} skill feat.
Glacierborn Shobhad.name: Glacierborn Shobhad

Glowsilk Lashunta.description:
The jungles of Castrovel are home to megafauna, mold storms, and wild magic. The main city of Jabask in the Glowsilk Jungle welcomes adrenaline seekers, as even reaching the city requires shuttle flights that zoom through routes with only inches of clearance. Residents of Glowsilk learn to be self-sufficient and anticipate danger.

You're a Glowsilk lashunta and excel at living without the safety guardrails of civilization. You become trained in Survival and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YtbPw4FSa86QAdRq]{Urban Survivalist} skill feat. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (such as from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against poison. This bonus increases to +2 for saving throws against a fungal poison.
Glowsilk Lashunta.name: Glowsilk Lashunta

Golarion Survivor Human.description: Your ancestors lived on Golarion, and though the precise circumstances of their survival are lost to the Gap, you strongly identify with the lost planet's cultures. You become trained in Golarion Lore, and you learn a bonus language that was spoken in your lineage's region of origin. You have familiarity with archaic weapons and, for purposes of proficiency, treat one archaic weapon of your choice that's a martial weapon as a simple weapon, or that's an advanced weapon as a martial weapon.
Golarion Survivor Human.name: Golarion Survivor Human

Gold-Blooded Madrosarai.description:
Aurum blood fills your veins, giving your skin a metallic sheen that seems to glow under light. Your bloodline is often associated with leadership and the ability to coordinate others.

You become trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.gUqvezs2zzoTXFAI]{Group Coercion} skill feat. If you roll a critical failure on an Intimidation check to [[/act coerce]] a humanoid, you get a failure instead.
Gold-Blooded Madrosarai.name: Gold-Blooded Madrosarai

Green Warden Kasatha.description:
As part of preparations to leave Kasath, scientists preserved every native plant, transplanting the cuttings to environmental gardens and food-producing farm pods on the Idari. Several prominent Great Families and their allies formed a clan dedicated to stewardship over the last remnant of their home world's ecosystems. Later, the same clan worked with planetary governments and Xenowardens in the Pact Worlds to create preserves where Kasath plants could grow wild once again. Half botany experiment, half diplomatic symbol of friendship, these oases are open to the public and teem with thick vegetation that requires constant care and upkeep.

You spent time aboard the Idari or near a friendship oasis, learning your clan's vocation. You're trained in Nature and Life Science Lore. You ignore difficult terrain caused by vegetation (such as a brush, jungle, or undergrowth).
Green Warden Kasatha.name: Green Warden Kasatha

Grumpy Skittermander.description:
Not all skittermanders are helpful. You're grouchy, gruff, and somber compared to the stereotypical cheerful, energetic skittermander. You might dislike helping, or the way you provide assistance is considered abrasive by normal cultural standards.

You become trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.xQMz6eDgX75WX2ce]{Intimidating Glare} skill feat.
Grumpy Skittermander.name: Grumpy Skittermander

Ha Quoia Maraquoi.description: Some maraquois have spent their entire lives climbing skyscrapers rather than kvashes. You're from a large city like Ha Quoia, the center of interplanetary travel on Marata. Though it would've been unthinkable to your ancestors, you've taken to life in the digital world with alacrity. You become trained in Computers. If you would automatically become trained in Computers (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You get a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Yn4jLPVWVE1vtAaF]{Access Infosphere} in large settlements and busy stations. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.GBGvxPo6rnlEXFMg]{Hologram Skeptic} skill feat.
Ha Quoia Maraquoi.name: Ha Quoia Maraquoi

Hardy Leshy.description:
Your body is adapted for planets that undergo harsh seasonal shifts. These shifts might be slow but severe, like those of Triaxus, or they might take place over timescales faster than a Pact standard year.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} feat. You treat environmental cold and heat effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on). You can go without food or water for twice as long as a typical creature can go without food or water, and you can go without sunlight for 2 weeks if you're photosynthetic without experiencing ill effects.

Hardy leshies are often photosynthetic.
Hardy Leshy.name: Hardy Leshy

Heartbroken Dragonkin.description: In the past your bonded partner died, and you remain devastated by their loss. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
Heartbroken Dragonkin.name: Heartbroken Dragonkin

Hellforged Android.description:
You're a hellforged android, a formidable, armored construction from Hell. You were originally built for the purposes of the Hellknights, but since your original construction, you might have severed your ties with their order. You're recognizable through the mighty armor that is woven into your body and that forms a profound bond with your soul.

You gain an attribute boost to Strength instead of Dexterity. You have @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.BJsogI1a5WSUHudq]{Hellforged Plates}. Hellforged plates are medium armor in the plate armor group that grant a +5 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +0, a check penalty of –3, a Speed penalty of –10 feet, and a Strength value of +3. They have the comfort trait, and you're trained in your Hellforged plates. You can never wear other armor or remove your Hellforged plates. You can etch armor runes onto Hellforged plates.
Hellforged Android.name: Hellforged Android

Hollow Leshy.description:
Your plant body is hollow, including a large open space within your arms that you can use to store objects. Your features might be reminiscent of a hollow-stemmed plant like bamboo or thistle, or you might have hollows protected by a hard plant material like seed shells or the rind of a gourd.
