You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.upMcjxPDgNOLuu7N]{Internal Compartment} standardized ancestry feat, except you can store up to 1 Bulk in your body, and it only takes 1 action to store an object this way.

Hollow leshies are often photosynthetic.
Hollow Leshy.name: Hollow Leshy

Hollow Orb Bantrid.description:
You or your parent lived for years on a low-calorie but high-protein diet. This caused your foot orb to gain a hollow, lattice-like cell structure that makes it lighter and capable of floating in water.

You gain a 20-foot swim Speed. While moving atop the surface of any liquid, you have a swim Speed equal to your Speed (or 20 feet, if higher).
Hollow Orb Bantrid.name: Hollow Orb Bantrid

Holon Seeker Hardor.description: You are descended from hardors who were once entrusted with the sacred task of scouting ahead to find sources of fresh water. These unforgiving journeys required dogged persistence and incredible fortitude. Though that specialty has faded into the past, the skills and hardiness it required have not. You're trained in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You can Hustle twice as long while exploring before you have to stop. Your strength and energy serve to bolster your allies as well. If you're in a group that is Hustling, you increase the total number of minutes the group can Hustle by 10 minutes, or by 20 minutes if you're 13th level or higher. You gain the Terrain Expertise feat for desert terrain.
Holon Seeker Hardor.name: Holon Seeker Hardor

Horizon Seeker Vesk.description:
Growing up climbing trees in jungles and forests, you've strengthened your tail to carry equipment while using both hands.

Your tail functions like an extra hand. You can hold one extra hand's worth of equipment with your tail, and you can use your tail to perform Interact actions. Your tail can be paired with another hand when you designate your active hands with the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action, and you can wield a shield or weapon in your tail when it's one of your active hands.

Additionally, you gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed.
Horizon Seeker Vesk.name: Horizon Seeker Vesk

Hostless Entu.description: You're an entu colony without a host. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.81EiW8ycG0Tmyl7x]{Tactical Symbiosis} action.
Hostless Entu.name: Hostless Entu

Hullborne Gnarefuroid.description: Gnarefuroids who grew up attached to starships fuse hull parts together into a permanent, spaceworthy carapace. Your carapace grants a +3 item bonus to AC and has a Dex cap of +2, a check penalty of –2, a Strength threshold of +2, and one upgrade slot. You can never wear other armor or remove your carapace. This carapace has the analog and comfort traits, and it can be improved by spending credits as if it were normal armor. Your carapace is medium armor in the ceramic group for abilities and for installing upgrades.
Hullborne Gnarefuroid.name: Hullborne Gnarefuroid

Hunter-Stalker Pahtra.description: You descend from a long line of hunters, and your fur is especially well suited to blending into multiple environments. As long as you're in a natural and undeveloped environment, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak}, to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist}, and to your Survival DC to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SB7cMECVtE06kByk]{Cover Tracks}.
Hunter-Stalker Pahtra.name: Hunter-Stalker Pahtra

Hylaxian Diplomat Trox.description:
Hylax teaches peace above all things, and you use this philosophy as a guiding light. You've become an expert in salvaging negotiations and relationships when situations go poorly.

You have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.6ON8DjFXSMITZleX]{No Cause for Alarm} skill feat. Once per day, if you would critically fail a Diplomacy check to make a [[/act request]], you can reroll the check and take the better result. This is a fortune effect.
Hylaxian Diplomat Trox.name: Hylaxian Diplomat Trox

Hylki Human.description:
You're from Akiton, a dusty red planet in the Pact Worlds. On this dwindling world, adaptability is key to survival. From the ancient and blood-soaked city of Arl, to the "thousand lights" of Maro and its gang wars, and all the inhospitable places in between, hylki humans live and breathe alongside the many other people of Akiton and eke out whatever existence they can. Hylki humans tend to be taller and stockier than other humans because they grew up in low gravity, and most have rosy-hued skin ranging from brilliant crimson to dusty rose.

You're trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feat.
Hylki Human.name: Hylki Human

Hyper-Augmented Raxilite.description:
Through an extensive process of body modification, you've adjusted your body shape to produce extra space for augmentations. This extra space never goes unused, and you're always tinkering around to try out new augmentations depending on your mood and the challenges ahead.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sEb6KmjQVdWNTqiu]{Augmented Body} general feat. When you swap the augmentation as though changing out a feat during downtime, you only need to spend 3 days to make the swap.
Hyper-Augmented Raxilite.name: Hyper-Augmented Raxilite

Icesure G'folian.description: Your ditty developed in a region of extreme cold, likely near mountains or the polar regions of Inthana, where your ancestors adapted to survive in the terrain without issue. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You ignore difficult terrain (but not greater difficult terrain) caused by ice or snow.
Icesure G'folian.name: Icesure G'folian

Imperious Contemplative.description: Whether it's a nurtured response or a natural consequence of your instinctive genius, your brain rewards you with endorphins whenever you witness your inferior rivals flailing helplessly in a mental sea. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.wI0g2nRfu2d0YFAd]{Shielding Arrogance} reaction.
Imperious Contemplative.name: Imperious Contemplative

Industrial Dwarf.description: Whether working vast ale vats or overseeing robotics factories, your clan has long honed its trade through technology. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for your clan's primary industry (such as Warfare Lore). When you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} a common item of your level or lower that's associated with this industry, you automatically know the formula and can use the Lore skill in place of Crafting. Your proficiency in this Lore makes you eligible for Crafting skill feat prerequisites, but only while you're interacting with items related to your clan's industry.
Industrial Dwarf.name: Industrial Dwarf

Industrialist Copaxi.description:
You're one of the elite members of copaxi society, a group collectively known as industrialists, reflecting the planetary government's driving goal for Tabrid Minor across the past few centuries. As an industrialist copaxi, your focus in recent years has been on making inroads with peoples from other planets—especially the elites, business owners, and investors who might benefit Tabrid Minor's governments and businesses.

You're trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You learn an additional language and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.eR73a0yWba7clUyC]{Management Material} skill feat.
Industrialist Copaxi.name: Industrialist Copaxi

Inflorescent.description: You draw from a wellspring of vital energy to remain constantly in bloom. Choose one cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.SnjhtQYexDtNDdEg]{Stabilize} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.kcelf6IHl3L9VXXg]{Vitality Lash}, which you can cast as a primal innate spell at will. This choice can't be changed. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against void effects.
Inflorescent.name: Inflorescent

Infogriefer Goblin.description: Goblins sometimes vent pent-up aggression by bothering others online. This behavior is so widespread (particularly in the Marixah Republic and Verces) that it's referred to as "gobbing" even when done by non-goblins. You become trained in Computers. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.fz1XOiQr3FJYRxJh]{Battle Gobbing} action.
Infogriefer Goblin.name: Infogriefer Goblin

Inheritor Copaxi.description:
You're one of a small group of copaxis who have earned the right to call yourself an inheritor of Gadrath, a powerful order of mystics and solarians that once called Gadrathar Fortress their home. With the help of its sapient robot guardians, you've rekindled in yourself a small amount of copaxis' ancient connection to copi during a pilgrimage to the ancient rotating citadel in the sky above Tabrid Minor's southern pole, allowing you to exert a small amount of control on the gravitational forces acting on your body.

As long as you're conscious, you take no falling damage, regardless of the distance you fall.
Inheritor Copaxi.name: Inheritor Copaxi

Inheritor Raxilite.description:
You were influenced by a great hero. Perhaps you grew up hearing stories of them, or perhaps you had a formative experience assisting them with a grand project. You might have added their initials or another acronym associated with them to your own name as a mark of respect, or you might be waiting to do so until you've accomplished a deed worthy of their name. Regardless of the nature of your connection to this hero, you hope to build upon their legacy.

Choose a field in which your hero excelled; you gain the feats and proficiencies listed. The options below are the default; your GM might allow other combinations based on the skill feats granted by different backgrounds.

Bioengineer: Your hero is a pioneer in bioengineering. They might have made their name working on critical systems like the IMAS or LFAN, or perhaps their innovations center around the living ships that hold cities on Raxil aloft. You become trained in Crafting (or another skill if you're already trained in Crafting), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.QLeMH5mQgh28sa5o]{Specialty Crafting} skill feat in life science.

Daredevil: Your hero is a risk taker; or perhaps they were, if one of their dangerous exploits cost them their life. They might have been an explorer of uncharted planets or an alpha tester for new technology. By following in their footsteps, you've forced your body to adapt to survive in harrowing conditions. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat.

Emissary: Your hero is a famous diplomat, such as one of the first emissaries to establish contact between Raxil and other worlds. You become trained in Society (or another skill if you're already trained in Society), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Bi0wdUuHsLxvSqrJ]{Digital Ambassador} skill feat.

Interstellar Pilot: Your hero was among the first raxilites to engage in interstellar travel. Like your hero, you enjoy experimenting with your starships to optimize their performance. You become trained in Piloting (or another skill if you're already trained in Piloting), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X5jW9JALKAKV18xj]{Express Driver} skill feat.

Physician: Your hero's work has saved countless lives, whether as a field medic, a hospital founder, or a leader in pharmaceutical development and distribution. You become trained in Medicine (or another skill if you're already trained in Medicine), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.wYerMk6F1RZb0Fwt]{Battle Medicine} skill feat.

Software Architect: Your hero has developed innovative software that revolutionized their field. You become trained in Computers (or another skill if you're already trained in Computers), and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ifQiKhl0Gt2CM7i9]{Phreaker} skill feat.
Inheritor Raxilite.name: Inheritor Raxilite

Inured Ikeshti.description: Due to extreme scarcity, negligence, or tragedy, your brood often consumed poisonous, rotten, or tainted food, or served as a living garbage disposal and ate garbage, refuse, waste, pollutants, and toxic sludge. Your body easily breaks down toxins. You gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat.
Inured Ikeshti.name: Inured Ikeshti

Iridescent Shirren.description: You descend from shirrens who were originally programmed as decoys for the ravenous Swarm. Your chitin is iridescent and creates shimmering patterns that fascinate and distract most other creatures. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QNAVeNKtHA0EUw4X]{Feint} at a range of 10 feet, rather than solely while within melee reach of your intended target. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lIZ9DhrkzM3AEQmX]{Shimmering Dazzle} action.
Iridescent Shirren.name: Iridescent Shirren

Irreproachable Contemplative.description: Just as antibodies isolate and eliminate pathogens in the bloodstream, your brain has evolved its own psychic defenses that deflect unwanted thoughts. You gain mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). If you roll a success on a saving throw against a mental effect that would apply the controlled condition, you critically succeed instead.
Irreproachable Contemplative.name: Irreproachable Contemplative

Itinerant Scholar Osharu.description:
Their love of knowledge and their careful natures make osharus in high demand as subject experts, master trainers, and scholars-in-residence across the galaxy. Osharus who believe they might want to be intergalactic scholars first undertake a series of voyages on Pabaq to test their taste for travel, taking pilgrimages to sites and campuses important in their specialty.

You become trained in one Lore skill of your choice and you become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} as a bonus feat.
Itinerant Scholar Osharu.name: Itinerant Scholar Osharu

Ivairan Elf.description:
Before the advent of Drift travel or shadow drives, elves toured the galaxy on century-long voyages in great starship caravans. You're one of the ivairan, descended from these ancient elven travelers. Your family still upholds the traditions of your ancestors by exploring the galaxy, learning about the civilizations they meet in their travels, and charting new and unknown courses through the wilds of the Vast.

During your daily preparations, you can reflect on what you've heard from fellow travelers and on your experiences visiting a city, space station, or planet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for a Lore subcategory about a specific place (such as Absalom Station Lore or Akiton Lore) until you make your preparations again. Since this feat is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for any character option.
Ivairan Elf.name: Ivairan Elf

Izalraan Izalguun.description:
Your ancestors, along with most izalguuns, left the Scoured Stars before the Gap to escape the influence of the god Kadrical. They then settled on a planet that later came to be known as Izalraan. Most izalguuns on Izalraan serve as laborers to provide for their people. In either case, a powerful bite from their formidable jaws is useful.

You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage, is in the brawling group, and has the finesse and unarmed traits.
Izalraan Izalguun.name: Izalraan Izalguun

Jajor Protector Hardor.description: The dangers on Dorjo have always come from the natural world, rather than other sapient beings, but the greater galaxy has exposed your people to a new kind of danger. You've honed your body to be even sturdier than your fellow hardors so that when threats arrive, you can be among the first to face them. You gain 12 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 10. You gain a +1 status bonus to Fortitude saves against disease.
Jajor Protector Hardor.name: Jajor Protector Hardor

Jeweled Orb Bantrid.description:
Whether you were part of a magic experiment, born at the convergence of multiple ley lines, or replaced your foot orb with sophisticated magitech, your foot orb is a giant shimmering crystal that resonates with magic.

Choose a magical tradition. You gain one cantrip from that magical tradition's spell list and can Cast this Spell as an innate spell at will, as a spell of your chosen tradition. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Whenever you gain an innate spell from a bantrid ancestry feat, change its tradition to your chosen tradition.
Jeweled Orb Bantrid.name: Jeweled Orb Bantrid

Jumping Atraxid.description: You make excellent use of your legs and are quite skilled at leaping. Some atraxids get around not only by walking or climbing, but jumping, easily leaping from surface to surface. You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ZBhvJ9O8MvBFAlhq]{Quick Jump} skill feat.
Jumping Atraxid.name: Jumping Atraxid

Jungle Brenneri.description:
You hail from the Clorwana jungles on Vanturan. The great trunks of trees are planted firmly on underwater shelves, and their immense canopies are one of few places on the planet that remain above the highest tideline. Rope bridges span the gaps between branches. Platform buildings provide stability for housing and other infrastructure, but movement through the Clorwanan canopy city requires regular climbing and scrabbling up ladders.

You become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You have a climb Speed of 20 feet.
Jungle Brenneri.name: Jungle Brenneri

Junker Goblin.description: You use jury-rigged tools, bits of string and wires, and a deceptively clever mind to craft just about anything. You gain an attribute boost to Intelligence instead of Charisma, but the free ancestry boost can't also be Intelligence. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.swg2tjUYIx6BPSH8]{Explosive Engineering} feat.
Junker Goblin.name: Junker Goblin

Jury-Rigging Raxilite.description:
You've installed a specialized surgical module that allows you to repurpose scrap metal to perform emergency repairs on your body.

You become trained in your choice of Crafting or Medicine (or another skill if you're already trained in both). Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes to feed 1 Bulk worth of scrap metal into your surgical module. If you do, you regain a number of Hit Points equal to @Damage[(@actor.level*5)[healing]]{five times your level}. Scrap metal is generally readily available for free.
Jury-Rigging Raxilite.name: Jury-Rigging Raxilite

Karapentu.description: You bonded with a karapal, a freshwater amphibian from Saaruq-5. You gain a swim Speed equal to your land Speed, and you gain the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.
Karapentu.name: Karapentu

Kasath Survivalist.description: You and your ancestors were among those who chose not to abandon your dying home world. Your people trek through wasted lands under dim skies, seeking shelter and resources even as they slowly dwindle. You might have finally decided to seek a better life, or perhaps you hope to convince others to return to Kasath with you. You can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.JuqmIAnkL9hVGai8]{Hustle} twice as long while exploring before you have to stop. If you're in a group that's Hustling, you increase the total number of minutes the group can Hustle by 10 minutes, or by 20 minutes if you're 13th level or higher. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.c9fHUSI5lRdXu1Ic]{Feather Step} feat.
Kasath Survivalist.name: Kasath Survivalist

Keen Sighted Vlaka.description: You have a particularly keen sense of vision, honed through generations of surviving on a world bathed in the dim light of a dying star. You gain darkvision.
Keen Sighted Vlaka.name: Keen Sighted Vlaka

Keen-Sighted Raxilite.description:
The community you grew up in often worked in shadowy places. You might have spent many hours in the tunnels at the heart of a flying city-ship. Or perhaps you lived on the surface, where your community helped mine materials that are essential for creating technological marvels. As a result, you were given a visual augmentation at a young age.

You gain darkvision.
Keen-Sighted Raxilite.name: Keen-Sighted Raxilite

Korasha Lashunta.description: You've chosen the adaptive genetics to become a korasha. You might be stockier and more muscular than other lashuntas. In addition to what you gain from your ancestry, you gain an attribute boost to Strength and an attribute flaw to Wisdom, but the free ancestry boost can't also be Strength. You gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}.
Korasha Lashunta.name: Korasha Lashunta

Krethiskar Cutoff Shirren.description:
You were awoken on Krethiskar after hundreds of years of hibernation. In appearance, you resemble the shirren's distant ancestor, the kucharn, with a fearsome spiked and armored carapace. However, your exposure to the szandite crystals after so much time has multiplied your telekinetic abilities such that you've become extremely sensitive to the psychic energy radiating off others.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]]. In addition, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.aIHY2DArKFweIrpf]{Command} as a 1st-rank occult innate spell once per day.
Krethiskar Cutoff Shirren.name: Krethiskar Cutoff Shirren

Krregr Po Talphi.description:
Nearly all talphi pups experiment with artistry during their youth, be it learning to master symbols with glowing paints or building small sculptures and other tactile art pieces from stone, metal, and crystals easily found throughout Vesk-4's cave systems. Some talphis enjoy their work so much, or find they have such a knack for it, that they become semiprofessional artistic diplomats. They spend their days making beautiful gifts with no practical function but to be given to other groups as a means of starting relationships on the right foot. Rumor has it that a group of krregrs were able to prevent countless casualties during the initial Veskarium invasion through a series of well-designed gifts given to strategically chosen invading officers.

You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. With an hour of work, you can attempt a @Check[crafting|dc:@self.level] check at the standard DC for your level to create a beautiful trinket of negligible Bulk out of readily available materials, such as a piece of scrap metal or stone. You can use Crafting instead of Diplomacy to [[/act make-an-impression skill=crafting]] by giving your target your most recently crafted trinket; if the trinket was crafted with that specific individual in mind, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to this check. Unless the target refuses or returns the trinket, you'll have to Craft a new trinket if you want to present your most recently crafted trinket to a different creature.
Krregr Po Talphi.name: Krregr Po Talphi

Ksarik Leshy.description:
Your body is made of plant matter that evolved through exposure to psychic energy on Castrovel. You're quadrupedal, and your face features vine-like tentacles that you can use to defend yourself; you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RdWNYoypgL5dMO0a]{Ancestral Unarmed Attack} (tentacle, 1d4 bludgeoning [agile, finesse, grapple, trip, unarmed], brawling weapon group) standardized ancestry feat. Ksariks generally recognize you as a member of their own species and avoid attacking you unless necessary for self-defense.

Ksarik leshies are always photosynthetic.
Ksarik Leshy.name: Ksarik Leshy

Legionnaire Ryphorian.description:
Whether you were born on the planet Triaxus or in a military facility far off in the Vast, your family has been part of the Skyfire Legion for generations. This massive mercenary company has been your extended family your whole life, and its concepts of honor and brotherhood are foundational to you. These military traditions have had a greater role in your early development than even the normal seasonal cycles that influence most ryphorians' lives. You've trained hard to make yourself ready for a life of discipline and battle, even if you eventually chose a path outside the legion.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BStw1cANwx5baL6d]{Armor Proficiency} feat. If your class makes you trained in all types of armor, you instead become trained in Athletics (or a skill of your choice if you're already trained in Athletics) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} skill feat.
Legionnaire Ryphorian.name: Legionnaire Ryphorian

Leisure Stage Mecenaic.description:
You've passed your 75th birthday and entered the final stage of the mecenaic life cycle. You've seen almost everything there is to see, and your steadying presence and serious demeanor is reassuring to those around you.

You're trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the No Cause For Alarm skill feat.
Leisure Stage Mecenaic.name: Leisure Stage Mecenaic

Lightning Bug Urog.description:
Your crystalline silicon physiology enables you to store a higher capacity of electricity, while a diet high in lithium allows you to retain the charge longer.

You gain electricity resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). Additionally, your cilia generate an extra-potent electromagnetic field. A battery regains 1 charge for every 10 minutes it's in your possession.
Lightning Bug Urog.name: Lightning Bug Urog

Lightning Wave Fonqugon.description:
Rodnarth's oceans are generally considered to be utterly impassable. The oceans produce intense static at unpredictable intervals. The cause of this static is unknown but is thought to be related to the combative nature of a deep sea colossus. Even the most curious fonqugons are reluctant to explore the depths and discern the truth. Whatever the cause of the static, it produces immense, electrically charged tidal waves. While the waves themselves don't typically reach inland fonqon groves, the massive blasts of ball lightning rolling off the waves can travel many hundreds of miles.

As a lightning wave fonqugon, the sudden shock to your system before your birth has made you quick to react and capable of withstanding shocks. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls with Perception, and you gain electricity resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Lightning Wave Fonqugon.name: Lightning Wave Fonqugon

Lime-Blooded Madrosarai.description:
Madrosarais with lime blood have often produced impressive innovations and enacted great changes throughout the Virtuum and beyond. The blood in these veins is seen as a path into many professions, but especially those where one works with objects.

You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ASy9AKEIRxPYUi5o]{Quick Repair} skill feat.
Lime-Blooded Madrosarai.name: Lime-Blooded Madrosarai

Liminal Ryphorian.description:
You were born during the brief spring or autumn seasons of Triaxus's eccentric orbits. You demonstrate a blend of both summerborn and winterborn traits. Before the advent of modern gene therapy and spaceflight, liminal ryphorians were even rarer than they are today and were viewed with awe and mystery. Even in present times, they're afforded status akin to that of a minor celebrity in some of Triaxus's more rural districts.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against all cold and fire effects, which increases to +2 when you reach 13th level. Additionally, you reduce the flat check DC to end persistent cold and fire damage you're currently taking from 15 to 10, which is reduced to 5 with appropriate assistance.
Liminal Ryphorian.name: Liminal Ryphorian

Listener Ysoki.description:
Your time near an Iridium Spire opened your mind to the Netherworld and tinged your fur silver, purple, or another unusual shade.

You become trained in Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in Occultism (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.4yWUVp205mJWuqNI]{Listen} action.
Listener Ysoki.name: Listener Ysoki

Lithe Nuar.description: While great in height, your frame never fleshed out as fully as most adult nuars, giving you a lithe and spindly appearance but allowing you to move with greater agility. Your Speed increases by 5 feet.
Lithe Nuar.name: Lithe Nuar

Living Codex Barathu.description:
You love learning and have cataloged all your experiences with other creatures and environments. After a lifetime of exploration, you've learned how to codify all your findings into your own genetic material. This dynamic algorithm enables you to share your knowledge and experience with others of your kind in vast collectives. To share with other ancestries, you've also learned how to interface your genetic code with computers and program them to create a vast database for others to access. While your experiences are extensive and varied, you've also gained a unique perspective on everything you've learned, allowing certain benefits to those who glean information from you specifically.

You're trained in Society (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Society). You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} on @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.
Living Codex Barathu.name: Living Codex Barathu

Locomotive Bantrid.description:
You are exceptionally good at handling the thousands of cilia on the underside of your body and spinning your foot orb with haste.

You have a Speed of 30 feet. Your body's excellent balance grants a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} and to your Reflex DC to avoid being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Tripped}.
Locomotive Bantrid.name: Locomotive Bantrid

Longsnout Ysoki.description:
The long snouts that run in your family give you a keener sense of smell than most ysoki. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine a creature's location. The GM will usually double the range if you're downwind from the creature or halve the range if you're upwind.

In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] a creature or object within the range of your scent.
Longsnout Ysoki.name: Longsnout Ysoki

Lowcrawler Talphi.description:
Growing up under extremely high gravity has shaped the skeletons of talphi pups, giving them low-slung cylindrical bodies and limbs that naturally stay close to their sides. Some pups develop a wide stance and dramatically hunched shoulders, which makes them look even shorter than other talphis' average modest stature but gives them an extraordinarily stable center of balance. So-called lowcrawlers have found a niche in many talphi groups scouting through narrow and potentially unstable caverns, protecting their companions from risk of falling. The occupying Veskarium forces often employ lowcrawlers to scout hard-to-reach locations.

Your body is stouter than most, and you sit uncommonly close to the ground. Despite your light weight and small frame, it's a challenge to take you off your feet. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your DCs against attempts to [[/act shove]] or [[/act trip]] you. This bonus also applies to saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to knock you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.3In9EAqKoYiCDmz4]{Feign Prone} action.
Lowcrawler Talphi.name: Lowcrawler Talphi

Luckless Worlanisi.description:
You're a member of a small community of worlanisis that have lived a starkly isolated life from the rest of the planet, deep in the volcanic caverns beneath Worlan's highest mountains rather than hopping from island to island like other worlanisis. The erroneously named "luckless" (so called because of their smaller horn-cones) were considered mythological ancestors, people found only in ancient bones buried in ruins, until shifting tectonic plates drove you to the surface.

You're much larger in stature than the average worlanisi, your blue skin tends toward paler shades from a lack of sun exposure, and your horn-cones are proportionately smaller. You are Medium in size and start with 8 HP instead of 6, but your time away from the bulk of your people has caused your psychic abilities to atrophy. You have neither Limited Telepathy nor Psychic Reverb, and you can't take worlanisi ancestry feats with the mental trait. Additionally, you gain resistance to fire damage equal to half your level (minimum 1) from your years in the hot, magma-lined tunnels.
Luckless Worlanisi.name: Luckless Worlanisi

Magic Dabbler Urog.description:
You seek to unravel the secrets of magic as though they were a science. Maybe you've found new efficiencies by combining magic and technology, or maybe you've discovered how to channel the divine without the need for gods. Either way, you've unlocked a magical knack to make your life easier.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.IEQmMRA1uMPb0rJo]{Ancestral Cantrip} standardized ancestry feat. If your epistemological approach is empirical, this is a primal spell; otherwise, it's an arcane spell. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell}.
Magic Dabbler Urog.name: Magic Dabbler Urog

Magic-Sworn Vulkarisu.description: You entered the world with two tails, alabaster fur, and a traditional week-long festival to celebrate your auspicious birth. Whether you're from a long line of magic-sworn or the first your family has ever seen, the periodic sparks of magic flowing from your fluffy tails serve as a constant reminder of your supernatural lineage. But despite what expectations your family has for you, ultimately you get to choose whether to wield or hide this remarkable talent. You gain one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an innate primal spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Magic-Sworn Vulkarisu.name: Magic-Sworn Vulkarisu

Magnetic Orb Bantrid.description:
Using a combination of an iron-rich diet, augmentations, and medication, you've developed a foot orb with a magnetic metallic core.

You gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed, but you can use this climb Speed only to climb on metal surfaces. You can move across metal surfaces using your land Speed even in zero gravity. While standing on a metal surface, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance} and to your Fortitude DC to avoid being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Repositioned} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shoved}.
Magnetic Orb Bantrid.name: Magnetic Orb Bantrid

Manifested Contemplative.description: Your brainwaves are so powerful that occult magic manifests and dances to the tune of your very thoughts. Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an occult innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Manifested Contemplative.name: Manifested Contemplative

Manufacturer Barathu.description: Your body is a living laboratory, allowing you to ingest raw materials and refine them into useful medicines and other products. You become trained in Crafting (or another skill of your choice if you're already trained in Crafting) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.VRLHQPDkjy0gbxBY]{Serum Crafting} feat.
Manufacturer Barathu.name: Manufacturer Barathu

Marixan Warhawk Orc.description:
You grew up on the Near Space world of Marixah at the height of its cold war with the nearby Gideron Authority. You have trained since you were born, preparing for a war your people have anticipated for decades. You might believe in the righteousness of your cause or believe the war needs to end quickly to save lives when it does begin.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Warfare Lore. When you perform the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity at the start of an encounter, in addition to the normal bonuses for using the Scout exploration activity, you can roll a Warfare Lore check instead of a Perception check both to determine your initiative and confirm whether or not undisguised and observed enemies are part of or trained by a military (using simple DCs as normal for @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}).
Marixan Warhawk Orc.name: Marixan Warhawk Orc

Massive Novian.description: You were born from a massive star or red supergiant and are much larger than the typical novian. Instead of Tiny, your size is Small. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry, rather than 6.
Massive Novian.name: Massive Novian

Matter Eater Urog.description:
The cilia that cover your body siphon off only the molecules from nearby objects that you need to live without harming the integrity of the objects around you.

You can keep yourself fed with any non-living material without using the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.49y9Ec4bDii8pcD3]{Subsist} downtime activity. Additionally, you gain poison resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Matter Eater Urog.name: Matter Eater Urog

Mercurial Dragonkin.description: Whether by fluke, the whims of fate, or deep-seated fear of codependency, you can't form a permanent partner bond. Instead, you can form a temporary partner bond. The time it takes you to form a partner bond is reduced to 10 minutes, and the duration of this partner bond is reduced to 1 day. You can choose to sever a partner bond early as a single action that has the concentration trait. If you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.UeMHbnnaXDa3sGfG]{Transfer Vitality} to your partner, reduce the Hit Point cost by 1 plus 1 for every 4 levels you have (to a minimum of 1).
Mercurial Dragonkin.name: Mercurial Dragonkin

Merged Barathu.description: You're a unique entity formed from the constant union of two or more barathus who enjoy the act of combination so much that they chose not to return to isolation as their former selves. You're Large instead of Medium. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against emotion effects.
Merged Barathu.name: Merged Barathu

Meyel's Chosen Pahtra.description: You have an undeniable streak of luck that you believe is a blessing from your ancestral god Meyel. You might come from a long line of mystics. Perhaps you were born at a holy site on Pulonis, or you reached out in fervent prayer at a time of crisis. Most of Meyel's chosen can point to at least one past event when their goddess might have intervened to save them from death or some other awful fate. Whether metaphorically or literally, you always seem to land on your feet. The first time each day that you critically fail a saving throw, you immediately reroll the saving throw as a free action; this is a fortune effect.
Meyel's Chosen Pahtra.name: Meyel's Chosen Pahtra

Mindstatic Orocoran.description: Your mind releases a steady psychic static that you can instinctively wield to scramble incoming mental signals, shielding you from mind control and psychic attacks. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.qjcTcdQpCVMJcNgi]{Static Shield} reaction.
Mindstatic Orocoran.name: Mindstatic Orocoran

Mire Dweller Osharu.description:
The inhabitants of the swampy Mire are hardier than their more studious brethren, and they often eschew academic pursuits in favor of more naturalistic fields like zoology or agriculture. You are well-acquainted with the flora and fauna of the swamps and extrapolate your naturalistic observations to species off Pabaq as well.

You become trained in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against plant, poison, and wood effects, and if you roll a success against a poison effect, you get a critical success instead.
Mire Dweller Osharu.name: Mire Dweller Osharu

Mod Fanatic Android.description: You or your previous iterations have modified your body to be compatible with armor upgrades, enabling you to personally customize your body and its capabilities. Your body has one armor upgrade slot that you can use to install armor upgrades and that doesn't count toward your armor's total number of upgrades. You can install and uninstall armor upgrades into your personal upgrade slot using the Install Upgrade activity. Choose one common armor upgrade with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this armor upgrade already installed in your upgrade slot (you don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting upgrade).
Mod Fanatic Android.name: Mod Fanatic Android

Moon Guard Copaxi.description:
You've lived a significant portion of your life on Sabraxid, Tabrid Minor's moon, in or around one of the many colonies that have sprung up in the recent decades as the government increases its focus on interstellar travel. You, along with most of the moon's copaxi residents, have had to face the undead remains of the warriors from the copaxi civil wars that were flung beyond the planet's atmosphere by powerful gravity-wielding copaxis.

As a moon guard copaxi, you've adapted to a harsh life on the fringes of the Sabraxid moon colonies. You gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects with the death or void trait.
Moon Guard Copaxi.name: Moon Guard Copaxi

Moonflower Leshy.description:
Your body is made from twisting vines accentuated by glowing orbs. Like the moonflowers you're related to, you might dwell on Galvix or have sprouted on another world.

Your size is Medium instead of Small. Additionally, you constantly shed bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose; this effect has the light and primal traits. Its counteract rank is equal to half your level (rounded down), and its counteract DC is equal to the higher of your class or spell DC.

You can suppress your light by spending one Interact action, at which point the light doesn't return until you restore it by spending 2 actions that have the concentrate and manipulate traits. When you restore the light, you can choose a new color.

Moonflower leshies are always photosynthetic.
Moonflower Leshy.name: Moonflower Leshy

Mottled Hide Ijtikri.description: Your home waters teemed with minerals that your mantle absorbed, developing into a thickened shell. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.I0BhPWqYf1bbzEYg]{Diehard} general feat.
Mottled Hide Ijtikri.name: Mottled Hide Ijtikri

Mutant Goblin.description:
Accelerated evolutionary tracks and a love for radiation means that many goblins frequently grow bizarre mutations. You gain the mutant trait. Select one mutation from the list below.

  • Bioelectricity You gain a bioshock unarmed attack that deals 1d4 electricity damage. Your bioshock attack is in the shock group and has the finesse, nonlethal, and unarmed traits.
  • Chromatophores You become trained in Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in Stealth (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} skill feat, except instead of a selected difficult terrain, you can use this feat while adjacent to or within areas of bright artificial light, such as a large neon sign or nightclub.
  • Extra Limbs You grow a second pair of arms. You can select the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.EPeo604ByeeAx3AL]{All Hands on Deck} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.61txGmMLr22B93cU]{Double Draw} standardized ancestry feats.
  • Flight You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet.
  • Gills You gain a swim Speed of 25 feet and can breathe underwater for 1 minute at a time.
  • Limited Telepathy You can communicate mentally with creatures within 15 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
  • Mutant Magic You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.IEQmMRA1uMPb0rJo]{Ancestral Cantrip} (primal; @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.thAHF1zxNplLCJPO]{Caustic Blast}) standardized ancestry feat, except the spell doesn't have the manipulate trait as you hock the glob of acid from your mouth.

  • Suckers You gain a climb Speed of 20 feet.
Mutant Goblin.name: Mutant Goblin

Nchaki Attendant Shirren.description:
You were raised in the underground Forever Halls of Liavara's shepherd moon Nchak, the center of Hylaxian worship in the Pact Worlds. You might have met the Forever Queen, the aspect of Hylax who dwells there. Her steady presence, dedication to peace and diplomacy, and understanding demeanor left an impression on you.

You're trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Once per day, you can use the Aid reaction to help an ally even if you haven't prepared to do so. At 9th level, you can do so once per hour.
Nchaki Attendant Shirren.name: Nchaki Attendant Shirren

Nelentu.description: Closely resembling a bat coated in oozing spores, you're a nelentu. You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed, and you don't need to have any hands free to Climb. Additionally, you can Climb to hang from ceilings and can hang for any amount of time without exerting any effort, even in your sleep.
Nelentu.name: Nelentu

Networked Android.description: Your body was modified to network seamlessly with other tech creatures. You gain shortwave, allowing you to communicate wirelessly with any creatures within 30 feet, as long as they have shortwave or are a construct with the tech trait. This doesn't give any special access to their thoughts or programming and communicates no more information than normal speech would. You can attempt Computers checks to Hack systems, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.abcKcLvAGE5AKig4]{Combat Hack}, create a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.0ZNErs9RICfOw1Nf]{Digital Diversion}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} without a hacker's toolkit or free hand at a range of 30 feet.
Networked Android.name: Networked Android

Never Wrong and Always Right Phasorq.description: If you're going to be up all night, you might as well read, and if you're reading, you might as well learn, and if you're going to learn something, you should never be truly wrong about it. You gain the Additional Lore skill feat. If you critically fail a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check for any Lore skill for which you've taken Additional Lore, you get a failure instead.
Never Wrong and Always Right Phasorq.name: Never Wrong and Always Right Phasorq

Newborn Ryphorian.description:
The birth of the Newborn, and the buildup to that cosmic event prior to the planet Aucturn's destruction, had a massive impact on the Pact Worlds solar system as well as the galaxy at-large. The psychic shock waves from this divine occurrence also did something thought to be unthinkable: it broke the connection some ryphorians have with the seasonal cycles of the planet of Triaxus. While you no longer carry any of the telltale signs of your connection back to your ancestral home world, you've developed a psychic predisposition toward feeling the emotions of others that makes it easier to trust your allies and suss out your enemies.

The circumstance bonus you gain from your notched ears feature applies even when you can't hear and to creatures who make no noise, but it doesn't apply when the creatures are both silent and immune to mental effects. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.IXl04yjeeqBiSZiy]{Sympathetic Bond} feat.
Newborn Ryphorian.name: Newborn Ryphorian

Next-Gen Raxilite.description:
You come from a family that has adopted the most avant-garde tech. They were always trying out the latest augmentations, undaunted by the potential risks of using untested models. They involved you in this process from the earliest days of your life, installing a new IMAS prototype inside your body when you were a baby. Fortunately, this experiment proved successful. Your cutting-edge IMAS lets you move faster than most other raxilites.

Your Speed is 30 feet.
Next-Gen Raxilite.name: Next-Gen Raxilite

Nightstalker Vesk.description: You've adapted to live in darkness, perhaps due to living underground, in dim starship corridors, under smoke-shrouded skies, or on a planet far from its sun. You gain darkvision.
Nightstalker Vesk.name: Nightstalker Vesk

Nomadic Vlaka.description: You live your life on the move, traveling the galaxy in an endless journey. You gain two additional languages of your choice, chosen from among the common and uncommon languages available to you. When you select the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.P9HCz0uR6xPHuw72]{Multilingual} skill feat, you gain three new languages instead of two.
Nomadic Vlaka.name: Nomadic Vlaka

Ocean Diver Barathu.description:
Your thirst for knowledge saw your gaze turn toward terrestrial exploration. Rather than the vastness of space or the surfaces of other planets, you've chosen instead to explore oceanic depths. Here you've found creatures and biomes as wondrous as those found in the far reaches of the galaxy. Such incredible findings must be shared, and you've adapted yourself to that task.

You gain the ability to breathe underwater, and you gain a swim Speed equal to your fly Speed. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.XYLK5aZ2WAMJGRAc]{Living Submersible} action.

SFS Note: Change the second sentence to read “When you do this, your body increases its size to Huge, and you can only use your swim Speed to move.”
Ocean Diver Barathu.name: Ocean Diver Barathu

Odd-Horned Nuar.description: You're one of the rare nuars who have an odd number of horns, which grow thicker and stronger than most. Your horn unarmed attack gains the deadly d8 trait.
Odd-Horned Nuar.name: Odd-Horned Nuar

Offworld Shobhad.description: You were born offworld, far from the influence of shobhad clans and the spirit of your ancestral home world. Your unique experience has allowed you to develop personal adaptations that serve you well. You lose the cold adapted ability but gain an additional 1st-level shobhad ancestry feat for which you meet the prerequisites.
Offworld Shobhad.name: Offworld Shobhad

Oozebonded Pahtra.description:
You're a Volosian, a deep-jungle pahtra of the southern Pulonis coasts who permanently bonded with a specially bred symbiotic ooze called a hymothoa. Your body secretes a slime that protects your coat, keeping it slippery and shiny.

You gain resistance to acid damage equal to half your level (minimum 1), and a +2 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves to avoid being Engulfed by creatures and to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} after being Engulfed.
Oozebonded Pahtra.name: Oozebonded Pahtra

Opensky G'folian.description: With an eye to the sky of your home, your ancestors had a deep yearning and connection with the hidden truths of the cosmos. You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gpzpAAAJ1Lza2JVl]{Detect Magic} cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You become trained in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in Religion (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Religion checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about different philosophies and creatures that originated on planes other than the Universe.
Opensky G'folian.name: Opensky G'folian

Outworlder Kalo.description: You've spent a significant portion of your life away from the oceans of Kalo-Mahoi, so you're particularly experienced at handling the challenges of life on dry land. Your land Speed is increased by 5 feet (to 25 feet for most kalos).
Outworlder Kalo.name: Outworlder Kalo

Pampered Ikeshti.description: Your brood was raised in a resource-rich region, such as the fey-touched forest outside of Great Gwaz, or offworld, perhaps on Castrovel, the Brethedan moon Marata, or Pulonis. You are unaccustomed to going without food and you don't gain the wasteland survivor ability. Instead, you gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry, rather than 6, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.N8Xz5fuW6o7GW124]{Fast Recovery} general feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.
Pampered Ikeshti.name: Pampered Ikeshti

Party Animal and Chemistry Whiz Phasorq.description: You've spent a large portion of your waking cycle experimenting with various types of poisons, and as such, you've developed a bit of a tolerance. To properly comprehend the effects of various chemical compounds, you understand, one must have firsthand experience. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against poisons.
Party Animal and Chemistry Whiz Phasorq.name: Party Animal and Chemistry Whiz Phasorq

Patagi Maraquoi.description:
Patagis (also the Maratan term for "death from above") have perfected the art of leaping from impossible heights to take down their prey with wondrous precision. You're descended from the most daring of these ancient maraquoi hunters who developed a specialized set of membranes spanning from your forearms down to your calves. Normally, these membranes lay flat against your sides and are barely noticeable, but when you leap from great heights, they balloon out and slow your fall.

You take no damage from falling and can control your descent, gliding slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 20 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.
Patagi Maraquoi.name: Patagi Maraquoi

Petrified.description: Your body is covered in thick, plated bark. Your bark is medium armor in the plate armor group that grants a +4 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, a Speed penalty of –5 feet, a Strength value of +3, and has the bulwark, comfort, and exposed traits. You can never wear other armor or remove the bark. You can etch armor runes onto the bark.
Petrified.name: Petrified

Pioneer Human.description:
You might be the child of explorers, interstellar colonists, or diplomats stationed on distant worlds far away from home. You feel an insatiable wanderlust to travel and explore, and this resolve helps protect you from succumbing to dangers you might encounter during your travels.

At 1st level, choose cold or heat. For the chosen element, environmental effects are one step less extreme (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on). You also become trained Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.4tTkRyOQ0VuRBac3]{Terrain Expertise} skill feat.
Pioneer Human.name: Pioneer Human

Plague-Hardened Trox.description:
You might have worked as a researcher at the Gretheshe vaults on Nchak that were flooded with a cornucopia of deadly, virulent pathogens, or you might have lived in the surrounding areas. No matter how it happened, you've built up an immunity to the pathogens within these vaults, and you have little fear of environmental risks that would kill a less hearty creature.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves to resist diseases. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.AmP0qu7c5dlBSath]{Toughness} general feat.
Plague-Hardened Trox.name: Plague-Hardened Trox

Plated Vesk.description: Your ancestors were the hardiest specimens of vesk, having traveled far and wide while enduring hostile environments. Your scales count as medium armor in the plate armor group. They grant a +3 item bonus to AC, have a Dex cap of +1, a check penalty of –2, and a Strength threshold of +3, and have the comfort and exposed traits. This item bonus increases to +4 at 5th level. You can wear a flight suit, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your scales, but you can't install armor upgrades.
Plated Vesk.name: Plated Vesk

Pod Brenneri.description:
You are tightly bonded to a pod and are particularly attuned to their emotions. Your pod consists of a number of willing allies equal to your level, selected when you make your daily preparations.

As long as you're within 100 feet of a member of your pod, you're aware if they are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, or otherwise under the effects of an effect with the emotion or mental trait. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of an effect.

You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.ntmBjxw7Hw81Fogq]{Empathic Assistance} action.
Pod Brenneri.name: Pod Brenneri

Prismeni.description: You have an innate connection to the Drift. You gain the prismeni trait, in addition to the traits from your ancestry. While you're in the Drift, you can automatically pinpoint the location of Drift beacons, Drift lanes, Drift engines, and other Drift-related technology within a 100-mile radius. If you're Piloting a starship that doesn't have a Drift engine, you can serve as a connection between the Drift and that starship. This is a 1-minute activity that has the concentrate trait, and it allows the starship you're Piloting to enter or exit the Drift. Once within the Drift, the starship travels via conventional thrusters, as normal. When you get a critical failure on a Piloting check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.hsUKPqTdAvWwsqH2]{Navigate} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.LXqcXRayK58inaKo]{Plot Course} through the Drift, you get a failure instead. You gain low-light vision, or you gain darkvision if your ancestry already has low-light vision. You can choose from prismeni feats and feats from your ancestry whenever you gain an ancestry feat.
Prismeni.name: Prismeni

Proudhome Pahtra.description: Your size is intimidating to most creatures, and you know how to use it to your advantage. Your size is Large instead of Medium. You're trained in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.
Proudhome Pahtra.name: Proudhome Pahtra

Psychic Binnaquid.description: Your family is among those binnaquids who learned to send telepathic messages while underwater for longer periods of time. You gain limited telepathy. You can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.
Psychic Binnaquid.name: Psychic Binnaquid

Psychic Blight Fonqugon.description:
Rodnarth's flora, like the flora on most planets, is generally mindless, but Rodnarth's swamps are occasionally plagued by a parasitic virus that affects its plant life, growing into brain-like tumors that animate all manner of plants and cause them to run amok. The blight mutates rapidly and can adapt to infest fonqugons, driving entire regions into a psychic haze. The nature of this phenomenon is, of course, unpredictable: some afflicted fonqugon settlements are driven to violence, others become so passive they die of starvation or exposure, and others turn to cannibalism. A fonqon tree that manages to fend off a psychic blight infection typically ceases reproducing for many years as it purges the virus from its system, but any fonqugons growing beneath the tree at the time of the exposure might be born as psychic blight fonqugons.

As a psychic blight fonqugon, your mind has adapted to withstand mental intrusion. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects, and you gain mental resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Psychic Blight Fonqugon.name: Psychic Blight Fonqugon

Psychic Messenger Mecenaic.description: Your telepathy is stronger than most mecenaicsʼ, allowing you to enhance your psychic communications with others. You can transmit simple images alongside your messages whenever you use limited telepathy. In addition, when a creature communicates with you via telepathy, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] against that creature.
Psychic Messenger Mecenaic.name: Psychic Messenger Mecenaic

Quarterling Halfling.description: You've adopted the cultures and habits of the ancestries around you. You've made these people your people and their home your own. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ihN8gkHSdPG9Trte]{Adopted Ancestry} general feat.
Quarterling Halfling.name: Quarterling Halfling

Queen's Court Formian.description:
You're one of the hive queen's attendants, whether a taskmaster, aristocrat, bureaucrat, entrepreneur, or other advisor. Many formians go their entire lives without ever directly interacting with their queen except through their hive mind, but members of the queen's court see the queen on a regular basis, and even while traveling far from the colony, their queen's regal influence still reaches them.

As a member of the queen's court, the constant presence of your queen in your mind makes you especially resistant to others' efforts to control you. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a mental effect that attempts to directly control your actions, you critically succeed instead. Additionally, thanks to your experience as a diplomat you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.MeBVpW5EIOzoEHCh]{Linguistic Prodigy} standardized ancestry feat, ignoring its prerequisites.
Queen's Court Formian.name: Queen's Court Formian

Questbound Dwarf.description:
Your clan has dedicated itself to galactic exploration aboard a dwarven generation ship like the Star Citadel Ironstar as part of the New Quest for Sky. Decades in space have left you more familiar with navigating stars than tunnels.

You become trained in Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in Piloting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. If you succeed at a Piloting check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.hsUKPqTdAvWwsqH2]{Navigate} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.LXqcXRayK58inaKo]{Plot Course}, you get a critical success instead. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks made to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about starships.
Questbound Dwarf.name: Questbound Dwarf

Radioscout Talphi.description:
The tunnels of Vesk-4, much like the surface, are plagued with pockets of powerful, dangerous radiation. Often invisible to the eye, these pockets drift through talphi territory unpredictably, presenting a mortal threat to any explorers in the area, especially during mining trips to the lodelands. Already extremely sensitive in conventional ways, some talphi noses have developed a knack for detecting pockets of radiation before they present a direct threat. Those who have a natural aptitude for radiation detection are highly sought-after companions on Vesk-4, as their presence can be the difference between life and death.

Your nose is attuned to things beyond the normal olfactory spectrum. The papillae at the end of your snout give you radiation sense, an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet that alerts you to the presence and severity of radiation and creatures that emit radioactivity but is blocked by 3 feet of dirt or wood, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or any force field.

Furthermore, you're experienced in dealing with radioactive materials. You become trained in Physical Science Lore. If you would automatically become trained in Physical Science Lore (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.
Radioscout Talphi.name: Radioscout Talphi

Red-Blooded Madrosarai.description:
Often considered the greatest warriors within madrosarai culture, red-blooded madrosarais have a strong association with unleashing their emotions in acceptably controlled bursts. The crimson-red blood grants you a connection with great madrosarai warriors of the past. You struggle to control your temper but can unleash it in moments of pure aggression at the pitch of battle.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Mfih4GjatO1sw2Ug]{Controlled Rage} action.
Red-Blooded Madrosarai.name: Red-Blooded Madrosarai

Reef Brenneri.description:
In shallower waters on Varturan, reefs create pockets of dense habitation. The crowding of different fish, invertebrates, and plants means that space is a luxury. You are adapted to tight conditions, as well as the highly social web of relationships that characterizes the reefs.

You're shorter than most brenneris and your large, wet eyes never quite matured past a childlike state. Despite your juvenile looks, you are an adult with considerable experience and expertise. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.VPUwqRHwijGcMVOH]{Big Wet Eye Blink} reaction.
Reef Brenneri.name: Reef Brenneri

Renewed Android.description: Many souls have inhabited your synthetic body before you, and you might incorporate a number into your name to honor them. You might know your body's history and work toward a goal bequeathed to you by a departed soul, or you might seek to learn the mystery of a forgotten legacy. Muscle memory hints at your body's past, and people you've never met sometimes recognize your face. The first time in a day that you lose the dying condition, you don't gain the wounded condition. You become trained in a skill of your choice that has the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat.
Renewed Android.name: Renewed Android

Replicant Android.description:
You're a precise copy of another living creature. You have all their memories at the time of your creation.

You become trained in Deception and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.XeL6uygxW4u2vMkF]{Favored Disguise} skill feat and can always @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} your favored disguises as if you had the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.zwWVolr4HkM5jjcQ]{Change Shape} feature. One of these favored disguises must be the replicated creature. You can attempt skill actions that normally require a character to be trained even if you're untrained and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to such checks. You become trained in one Lore skill of your replicated creature's home world, organization, species, or settlement.

SFS Note: Replicant androids do not gain the memories of the individual they replicate.
Replicant Android.name: Replicant Android

Resettled Izalguun.description:
You are one of the many izalguuns who have left their home worlds behind and have found new planets to settle down in across the galaxy. You've become adept at maneuvering the social labyrinth of the wider galaxy without divulging your origins.

You become trained in Deception. If you would automatically become trained in Deception (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.B6HbYsLBWb1RR6Fx]{Charming Liar} skill feat.
Resettled Izalguun.name: Resettled Izalguun

Retrograde Contemplative.description: Contemplatives' guided evolution has shrunk their limbs and expanded their immense brains. Rarely, by some genetic quirk, a contemplative like you is born with a body more closely resembling your less specialized ancestors. With longer, stronger limbs, you are still unmistakably a contemplative. You lose the atrophied trait. In addition, you gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6.
Retrograde Contemplative.name: Retrograde Contemplative

Rime Walker Pahtra.description: You've adapted to cold environments by growing a fluffy fur coat. You might be the descendant of ancient pahtras who dwelled in the frigid regions of Pulonis long before the Veskarium's exploitation changed its climate, or you might have unlocked this genetic potential through bioengineering. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
Rime Walker Pahtra.name: Rime Walker Pahtra

Roavisha Maraquoi.description:
Only a very small number of maraquois are born with the potential to commune directly with the ancestral wellspring. You were born with the rare talent to draw upon the knowledge of thousands of maraquoi ancestors for advice and guidance. Your community might see you with some degree of reverence.

You become trained in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in Religion (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.vOQ6BYpQpHd4IycO]{Tap Wellspring} action.
Roavisha Maraquoi.name: Roavisha Maraquoi

Rubberlimb Orocoran.description:
Your limbs are rubbery, making it tough for others to get a grip on you.

You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus on checks to [[/act escape]]. In addition, you don't treat tight spaces that don't require you to [[/act squeeze]] as difficult terrain.
Rubberlimb Orocoran.name: Rubberlimb Orocoran

Rugged Explorer Barathu.description:
You yearn to explore beyond Bretheda and Liavara and seek out challenging and physically demanding environments. Such places often contain dangerous flora and fauna, or perhaps very inhospitable native humanoids. To deal with such threats, you've genetically modified your body to make it hardy and resilient, creating your own protective shell of mineral deposits.

This shell counts as medium armor in the composite armor group. It grants a +2 item bonus to AC, has a Dex cap of +2, a check penalty of –2, a Strength threshold of +2, and has the comfort and exposed traits. This item bonus increases to +3 at 5th level. You're trained in your shell. You can wear a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.dnv1OFVU6BpyfAWi]{Flight Suit}, but you can't wear other armor. You can etch armor runes onto your shell, but you can't install armor upgrades.
Rugged Explorer Barathu.name: Rugged Explorer Barathu

Runha Mechanic Hardor.description: You've trained to be part of the army of engineers required to keep the massive desalination rigs of Dorjo operational, or to work on one of the thousand other interconnected systems your people depend upon. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the Quick Repair feat.
Runha Mechanic Hardor.name: Runha Mechanic Hardor

Saberine Pahtra.description: Saberine pahtras carry far more muscle than the average pahtra and are built for hand-to-hand combat. Instead of the normal attribute boosts, you can choose to gain a boost to Strength, a boost to Charisma, a free boost, and a flaw in Intelligence. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RdWNYoypgL5dMO0a]{Ancestral Unarmed Attack} standardized ancestry feat twice.
Saberine Pahtra.name: Saberine Pahtra

Sageborn Elebrian.description: You have a natural talent for magic. This might be due to the presentation of ancient elebrian genes, or maybe you were exposed to a burst of arcane energy that awakened and turbocharged your magical senses. Choose one cantrip from any tradition. You can cast this cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Sageborn Elebrian.name: Sageborn Elebrian

Salvation's End Dwarf.description:
You grew up on Golarion, following Torag's Quest for Sky. One day, a group of strangers arrived, claiming to be from the surface… and the stars beyond. These "starfinders" told your clan, Clan Marbleheart, that you lived inside a simulation. Your whole reality was a lie created by the guiding intelligence of the artificial moon of Salvation's End. Though Clan Marbleheart has escaped and is slowly integrating with other dwarves, you are displaced in time and might never truly understand the galaxy you've been thrust into.

You have familiarity with archaic weapons. For the purposes of proficiency, treat one martial archaic weapon of your choice as a simple weapon or an advanced archaic weapon as a martial weapon. If that weapon has the dwarf trait and you succeed at a saving throw against a fear effect while wielding it, you get a critical success instead. Otherwise, that weapon gains the dwarf trait as long as you wield it.
Salvation's End Dwarf.name: Salvation's End Dwarf

Sand Roamer.description: Your ancestors roamed blasted terrain leached of vital nutrients by the Veskarium. You're shorter and stockier than most pahtras, with wide, tufted ears and fur-covered paw pads. Your size is Small instead of Medium. You ignore difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by sand and gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Sand Roamer.name: Sand Roamer

Scoured Stars Izalguun.description:
Your ancestors remained in the Scoured Stars System on their home planet of Agillae-4 when most izalguuns fled. Those who stayed behind had to abandon their major settlements, which fell into ruin as the survivors took up a nomadic lifestyle, scavenging technology from the remains of their previous civilization. You're accustomed to working with technology without having the proper tools.

You become trained in Computers. If you would automatically become trained in Computers (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You don't need a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.qqjDcCW118ySAlAS]{hacking toolkit} to interface with a computer to perform the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.RF8xNJ8QsMwogerB]{Hack} action, instead making do with whatever tools are at hand. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.A2T7BjMzvTg8KMMd]{Undo, Undo!} reaction.
Scoured Stars Izalguun.name: Scoured Stars Izalguun

Scrabbler Skittermander.description: You never mastered coordinating all six of your arms for manual manipulation, instead using the lowest two limbs for the extra mobility, balance, and stabilization of a natural climber. You have four arms (rather than six) and four legs (rather than two). You gain a climb Speed equal to your base land Speed and can climb using your feet, leaving your four arms free.
Scrabbler Skittermander.name: Scrabbler Skittermander

Self-Focus Copaxi.description:
You've broken away from many of the very rigid modern-day societal expectations present among copaxis on Tabrid Minor that require you to sacrifice from your own life for the sake of the industrialists. In ancient times, copaxis didn't have such regimented lives, and the variety of copaxis' physical forms was much greater.

As a so-called "self-focus copaxi," you've rediscovered the art of focusing inward on the way your body's polyps grow and adapt, giving you greater control over your physical form than most copaxis. You gain any two of the following copaxi ancestry feats: @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.1ir4Hv9zuMXyPCQW]{Aggressive Antlers}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.JGMZzSoRGTIdZ4lY]{Armored Shell}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.TadvEQLY24jwF2Mb]{Coral Fists}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.fjBqZlWv8ZhDwLxC]{Copaxi Scent}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.1sYa9VjN1p27MLqs]{Four-Armed Copaxi}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sjl8Wwigz3IqkkMt]{Multi-Legged Copaxi}.
Self-Focus Copaxi.name: Self-Focus Copaxi

Shadowskin Talphi.description:
Most talphis spend the better part of their lives, especially their formative years, in the darkness of tunnels deep below the ground. Some of these pups form a deep connection to the darkness itself, rather than the resonance of stone or the constant spinning of the planet's core.
