Even without glowing markers, they're at home in the shadows, trusting their noses to help them navigate the dark and to keep them safe. They often have darker fur coats than other talphis and sometimes use matte, non-glowing pigments to paint patterns upon their fur and clothing to stay concealed.

You've long felt at home in the dark, and you've adapted to use this tendency to your advantage. You gain darkvision, allowing you to see in darkness and dim light just as well as you can in bright light. However, in darkness, you see in black and white only.
Shadowskin Talphi.name: Shadowskin Talphi

Sharp-Eyed Sarcesian.description: Your overlarge eyes have adapted to function well in poor lighting conditions. You gain darkvision.
Sharp-Eyed Sarcesian.name: Sharp-Eyed Sarcesian

Sharp-Toothed Vlaka.description: You have the strong jaw and sharp teeth of a predator, making your mouth a dangerous weapon. You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. Your jaws are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.
Sharp-Toothed Vlaka.name: Sharp-Toothed Vlaka

Shifthide Orocoran.description:
Your mottled flesh can shift color, granting you temporary, ever-shifting camouflage.

During your daily preparations, you can select a specific terrain from the following: arctic, desert, forest, mountain, plains, space, swamp, or urban. Your skin adopts a tone that could generally blend with such an environment. You become trained in Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in Stealth (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.pWMwGj8lnOpkU3Hr]{Shifthide Camouflage} action.
Shifthide Orocoran.name: Shifthide Orocoran

Shiny Skittermander.description:
While most skittermanders can trace their lineage back generations on Oeddertchonk or within the areas they've traveled, yours can't. Your family history claims that, somewhere in your family tree beyond memory or record, an adventurous ancestor had a dalliance with a playful fey, causing random blessings to occasionally show up in their descendants. Sometimes known as "glittermanders," your heritage imparts you with a lustrous sheen of fur. This strange influence has now manifested in you.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.bXLJtouJRWQXxLUP]{Shine} action.
Shiny Skittermander.name: Shiny Skittermander

Shipborn Dragonkin.description: Your ancestors adapted to live on a starship or in a settlement sized for people much smaller than your own. Being large was a disadvantage—one that subsequent generations shed. Instead of Large, your size is Medium. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kMcV8e5EZUxa6evt]{Squeeze}, and you can use Acrobatics or Athletics when you Squeeze.
Shipborn Dragonkin.name: Shipborn Dragonkin

Shipborn Kasatha.description: You were one of the kasathas born and raised on the Idari worldship that now orbits the Pact Worlds' sun. Your family kept hope and tradition alive while enduring the hardships of lengthy space travel. For you, the Idari is the only home you've ever known. When you roll a success on a saving throw against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.
Shipborn Kasatha.name: Shipborn Kasatha

Shipborn Ysoki.description:
You were born aboard a starship, inside a space station's access corridors, or another similar environment. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in Piloting (from your background or class, for example), you become trained in another skill of your choice. If you get a success on a Piloting check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.hsUKPqTdAvWwsqH2]{Navigate} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.LXqcXRayK58inaKo]{Plot Course}, you get a critical success instead.

You've adapted to maneuvering in close quarters. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.21WIfSu7Xd7uKqV8]{Tumble Through} the spaces of Medium or larger enemies, and the presence of an enemy doesn't make the squares difficult terrain.
Shipborn Ysoki.name: Shipborn Ysoki

Shrouded Mantle Ijtikri.description: Your soft, flexible mantle is better suited to absorbing light and dampening sound than deflecting blows. You're trained in Stealth. If you would automatically become trained in Stealth (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.beyw5bdA5hkQbmaG]{Terrain Stalker} feat, and you can select shallows as a unique option for that feat, allowing you to creep through tide pools, wetlands, and other shallow water.
Shrouded Mantle Ijtikri.name: Shrouded Mantle Ijtikri

Skilled Human.description: Your ingenuity allows you to train in a wide variety of skills. You become trained in one skill of your choice. At 5th level, you become an expert in the chosen skill.
Skilled Human.name: Skilled Human

Skitter Raised.description: You've spent your life as part of a tight-knit community, where teamwork makes the dream work and crowds are giant group hugs waiting to happen. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.KpFetnUqTiweypZk]{Group Impression} skill feat. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Aid an ally at skill checks that don't have the attack trait.
Skitter Raised.name: Skitter Raised

Sky Scavenger Copaxi.description:
You frequently traverse the skies of Tabrid Minor in search of treasures and knowledge hidden on its abandoned and forbidden floating sky cities. As a sky scavenger copaxi, you're constantly on your guard against things that might knock you off the planet's floating cities. Your body has become accustomed to constant, slightly anomalous gravitational forces, and you've learned to exert subtle control over them to keep yourself safe.

If any effect would force you to move 10 feet or more, you're moved only half the distance. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.QicdNj8KJd0WrPzv]{Steady Descent} copaxi ancestry feat.
Sky Scavenger Copaxi.name: Sky Scavenger Copaxi

Sky-Sworn Vulkarisu.description: You hail from a line of traditional canopy dwellers who glide from tree to tree using a furred flap that extends from your wrists to your ankles called a patagium. Most sky-sworn vulkarisu can trace their lineage to guardians of some of the oldest woods on Castrovel. Traditionalists claim the trees protect the warm light of the sky from the cold shadows of the earth, believing bare trees are the source of winter's deadly chill. Your bones and musculature have developed to allow your body to use this anatomy to glide safely to the ground even when @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}. You take no damage from falling, regardless of the distance you fall.
Sky-Sworn Vulkarisu.name: Sky-Sworn Vulkarisu

Slitherskin Orocoran.description: Your skin is slick with a thin layer of toxic secretions. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oKLA4xGqOkugw45C]{Slitherskin} reaction.
Slitherskin Orocoran.name: Slitherskin Orocoran

Sniper Shobhad.description: Special techniques developed over centuries and passed from generation to generation have helped make shobhad-neh some of the most feared snipers in the Pact Worlds, and with good cause. If you are holding a two-handed gun in your inactive pair of hands, whenever you fail at a Strike made with a weapon or unarmed attack using your active hands, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} as a free action.
Sniper Shobhad.name: Sniper Shobhad

Soldier Formian.description:
You're a soldier formian, tasked with protecting the peace, both between your colony and the various peoples of Castrovel, and among the Colonies themselves. Even during peacetime, countless soldiers patrol and protect formian colonies, guard their queen, and train for whatever conflict might arise next—the generational memories of their ancestors' constant brutal wars encouraging their battle-readiness at all times.

As a soldier formian, you become trained in Warfare Lore. If you would automatically become trained in Warfare Lore (such as from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RdWNYoypgL5dMO0a]{Ancestral Unarmed Attack} (jaws) feat.
Soldier Formian.name: Soldier Formian

Song of Ice Ord.description: In most of Lazel's tunnels, a combination of radiant heat from the surface and geothermal heat from below keeps the temperature relatively comfortable, but you grew up in a town that rests near the poles or away from underground heat sources, and your people have had to adapt. A lifetime in cold stone passages has thickened your skin and bolstered your physique. You have resistance to cold equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Song of Ice Ord.name: Song of Ice Ord

Song of Songs Ord.description: You've studied the haunting, howling compositions of your ancestors and perhaps developed some of your own. Your resonant voice has the capacity to draw an audience in and make them forget the world around them. You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the Fascinating Performance skill feat.
Song of Songs Ord.name: Song of Songs Ord

Song of the River Ord.description: Not content simply to walk the tunnels of your planet, you discovered that swimming through the innumerable winding underground rivers opened a whole new world for you to explore. Your large hands and feet and powerful tail lend themselves well to picking up, or fighting against, rushing currents. You gain a swim Speed of 15 feet.
Song of the River Ord.name: Song of the River Ord

Song of the Sun Ord.description: Unlike most of your kin, you've spent extensive time out in the sun, on the surface of Lazel or another world. Your scaly skin has taken on brighter hues, and the variegated patterns that cover your body stand out in bold contrast. Even though you can't see it, the light of the stars floods your senses and invigorates you. You become trained in Acrobatics. If you would automatically become trained in Acrobatics (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. When in an area of bright light, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatic checks to [[/act balance]], [[/act tumble-through]], and Squeeze.
Song of the Sun Ord.name: Song of the Sun Ord

Sonic Aurora Fonqugon.description:
Charged particles from Rodnarth's sun, Jonid's Star, can sometimes hit the planet's atmosphere at an improbable but especially destructive angle. The reaction causes an intensely beautiful aurora, but the thunderous booms and blinding flashes accompanying such events drive most fonqugons and other creatures to seek shelter.

As a sonic aurora fonqugon, you're especially sensitive to light and sound. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]], and you gain sonic resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Sonic Aurora Fonqugon.name: Sonic Aurora Fonqugon

Sovyrian Elf.description:
Sovyrian is the ancestral birthplace of all elves, and it's your home. You might trace your lineage back hundreds of generations of elves, or your family might have returned to Castrovel only recently as refugees of the Gap. You've honed your talent for untangling magical mysteries, and your sixth sense for missing links also helps you in spotting hidden agendas in business and politics.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} and a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made to Sense Motive. When you attempt a check to [[/act sense-motive]], the Perception DC doesn't increase when your target is concealing their features or otherwise hidden from you. In addition, you learn the Castrovelian language.
Sovyrian Elf.name: Sovyrian Elf

Spacefaring Izalguun.description:
You've left your home planet to wander the galaxy. Wandering for so long has given you the chance to perfect your skills at wayfaring. You become trained in Piloting. If you would automatically become trained in Piloting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. If you roll a success on a Piloting check to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.hsUKPqTdAvWwsqH2]{Navigate} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.LXqcXRayK58inaKo]{Plot Course}, you get a critical success instead.

In addition, you've come across people of myriad backgrounds throughout your travels and have heard dubious rumors aplenty. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.1Bt7uCW2WI4sM84P]{Dubious Knowledge} skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.
Spacefaring Izalguun.name: Spacefaring Izalguun

Spore-Producing Leshy.description:
Your body is made of fungi or plant material that would typically reproduce using spores or pollen. Your spores are infused with concentrated primal magic that can trigger dangerous allergic reactions. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.RdWNYoypgL5dMO0a]{Ancestral Unarmed Attack} (spore pod, 1d6 poison [range increment 20 feet, unarmed], poison weapon group) standardized ancestry feat. You become immune to the spore pods of spore-producing leshy.

Spore-producing leshies are sometimes photosynthetic.
Spore-Producing Leshy.name: Spore-Producing Leshy

Squentu.description: You're a union of entu and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.alien-core-bestiary.Actor.ONe5XNvapxGSRlnP]{Squox}. Your size is Tiny instead of Small. You gain an attribute boost to Dexterity instead of Constitution. You gain precise scent with a range of 30 feet. This means you can use your sense of smell to determine the exact location of a creature.
Squentu.name: Squentu

Stagehand Elebrian.description: You love being on the other side of the camera. You've spent your formative years rigging scenes, hauling props, and making media magic as a stagehand in the Halls of the Living. You're either trained in Acrobatics and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.CnqMJR8e9jqJR7MM]{Steady Balance} skill feat, or you're trained in Athletics and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.09PurtIanNUPfNRq]{Combat Climber} skill feat. If you would automatically become trained in your chosen skill (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
Stagehand Elebrian.name: Stagehand Elebrian

Star Marked Vlaka.description: You witnessed the miraculous rebirth of the dying star Sota. Your coat or eyes are marked with starbursts that shine with the light of the stars. With a moment's thought, you can cause these star markings to shed bright light in a 40-foot radius (and dim light to the next 40 feet). This light has the light and occult traits. You can spark or extinguish this light using a single action, which has the concentrate trait. You can't activate this ability when you're beyond the energy of a sun or stars, such as in the Drift or on another plane of existence where these celestial bodies don't exist.
Star Marked Vlaka.name: Star Marked Vlaka

Static Mind Lashunta.description:
Historical records show that ancient lashuntas lacked their modern day psychic powers and that the evolution of those powers arose with communal living and intensified with gene manipulation. You possess dormant genes from this primeval era, so you never developed the telepathic abilities of a typical lashunta, or perhaps you lost the ability to access them later in life.

You can't use any form of telepathy, including the limited telepathy granted by your ancestry, nor do you count as having telepathy for the purposes of meeting prerequisites. Creatures with telepathic abilities sense your mind as a rush of static. Your mind automatically attempts to counteract effects that access your mind or thoughts (such as @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.vLzFcIaSXs7YTIqJ]{Message}, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.KHnhPHL4x1AQHfbC]{Mind Reading}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.HOYa3N9R5VLS1kvv]{Thoughtsense}) using your Perception modifier as the counteract modifier. You can still willingly hear the thoughts of creatures who communicate with telepathy and willingly communicate telepathically using a class feature, such as a mystic's group chat.
Static Mind Lashunta.name: Static Mind Lashunta

Stellar Gnome.description:
You're so drawn to the natural beauty and wonder of the cosmos that your skin and hair might sparkle with starlight. You might respect or revere Ibra, Desna, Sarenrae, and other deities of the stars, or you might have a profound fascination with various specific stars. Whether you live on the Burning Archipelago or on a star-orbiting solar station, you likely want to find your own patch of space to admire the stars without the hubbub of space traffic.

You become trained in Sun Lore and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Piloting or Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.hsUKPqTdAvWwsqH2]{Navigate} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.fJImDBQfqfjKJOhk]{Sense Direction} while you can see stars. Additionally, you can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light} cantrip as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Stellar Gnome.name: Stellar Gnome

Stellar Nomad Kasatha.description: You choose to travel abroad, leaving your birthplace to embark on a journey through the wider cosmos. During your daily preparations, you can study a particular ancestry, faction, philosophy, or religion to learn one of their edicts or anathemas and gain a broader understanding of that culture's customs and traditions. While you follow that edict or anathema, you become trained in the associated lore (such as Vesk Lore or Damoritosh Lore). This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this training is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a permanent character option like a feat or a skill increase.
Stellar Nomad Kasatha.name: Stellar Nomad Kasatha

Stellar Sarcesian.description: You have an intrinsic connection to the cosmos and can channel these stellar forces into magic. Choose one cantrip that has at least one of the following traits: darkness, light, vital, or void. You can cast this cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Stellar Sarcesian.name: Stellar Sarcesian

Stone-Blooded Madrosarai.description:
One of the muted madrosarai bloodlines, stone-bloods are often employed as medics or philosophers. You always take time to analyze a situation rather than reacting rashly.

You can cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.NkvRoN33RbDg3fl9]{Analyze Target} cantrip as an arcane innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Increase the status bonus granted by analyze target by 1.
Stone-Blooded Madrosarai.name: Stone-Blooded Madrosarai

Stonehail G'folian.description: Thick chitin enhances your shell, and you might even descend directly from a strain of massive g'folians known to dwell within the deepest mountains of Inthana. You can choose to become Large instead of Medium when you select this heritage. You gain 10 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 8 and gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against diseases and poisons.
Stonehail G'folian.name: Stonehail G'folian

Stormrider Dragonkin.description: You were born and raised on a volatile world wracked by destructive storms and powerful winds. Learning to fly in such conditions has conditioned you into an exceptional aerialist. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight and your fly Speed increases by 5 feet.
Stormrider Dragonkin.name: Stormrider Dragonkin

Student of Creation Orc.description:
The spiritual connection between you and the missing deity, Torag is strong. Where departed orcs are thought to battle at Torag's side in some cosmic battle of the divine, you remain in the universe to help build. Unlike those who grew up among dwarves or workers for the azrinarans of Apostae, you spent a life wandering and helping where you could, focused on rebuilding. Outsiders might not know much of your background, while those who know about orc history see you as a symbol of hope. Wherever you go, some people inevitably look to you for assistance in putting things back together.

You become trained in Crafting, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.ASy9AKEIRxPYUi5o]{Quick Repair} skill feat.
Student of Creation Orc.name: Student of Creation Orc

Summerborn Ryphorian.description:
You were born during one of Triaxus's long summers. Typically dark-skinned, wide-eyed, and with completely hairless bodies except for their inner ears, summerborn ryphorians have a reputation for being more artistic, flighty, and progressive than their winterborn kin. You can also secrete fine oils through your skin that protect you from the worst of heat dangers and give you an attractive, glistening appearance popular in galactic media periodicals. To augment their bodies, many summerborn ryphorians are known to sport tattoos.

You gain fire resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental heat effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible heat becomes extreme, extreme heat becomes severe, and so on).
Summerborn Ryphorian.name: Summerborn Ryphorian

Sunkissed Human.description:
Your ancestors might have lived in high-gravity areas, such as the Burning Archipelago near the Pact Worlds' sun, the moons of the gas giant Bretheda, or worlds like Echidea, and eventually they adapted to these environments over generations. Sunkissed humans are so named by the followers of solar gods who make up a large proportion of those living near the sun, viewing their heritage as a blessing. Humans kissed by a sun tend to have more melanated skin.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to flat checks rolled against @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealment}. Whenever you're affected by the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} condition, reduce the duration of the effect by 1 round. You become trained in Religion. If you would automatically become trained in Religion (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.NY2R5hNgdkSRPkTV]{Religious Talisman} skill feat (even if you don't meet the feat's prerequisites); choose any star- or sun-themed god.
Sunkissed Human.name: Sunkissed Human

Surithic Worlanisi.description:
You've pursued the psychic crafts that your ancestors used during ancient times. The psychic resonance your horn-cones invite can be painful, yet through discipline and perseverance, you've developed a semblance of your ancestors' hunting prowess.

By focusing on psychic echoes left behind by your prey, you're able to hunt and track in the most inhospitable conditions—even the vacuum of space. You're trained in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You have the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.urQZwmzg2kS53vd5]{Experienced Tracker} skill feat. In addition, you have imprecise thoughtsense with a range of 20 feet. However, your weakness to mental damage from psychic reverb increases to be equal to half your level (minimum 1).
Surithic Worlanisi.name: Surithic Worlanisi

Survivalist Shobhad.description: Shobhad-neh are renowned for their talents as scouts and guides, talents they have honed over millennia of existence on their harsh home world of Akiton. As an inheritor of these skills, you are exceptionally talented at seeing to your own subsistence and even that of others while still performing other critical tasks. You can perform the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.kV3XM0YJeS2KCSOb]{Scout} exploration activity at the same time as the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} exploration activity. During downtime, you can perform the Subsist downtime activity alongside any one other downtime activity you are capable of performing.
Survivalist Shobhad.name: Survivalist Shobhad

Suskillon Cutoff Shirren.description:
Unlike most shirrens, who became independent from the Swarm hundreds of years ago, you were on Suskillon when the Crown of Hylax ripped you out of the hive mind into lonely autonomy. Perhaps you fled or surrendered—either way, you decided that independence from the Swarm suited you. Designed from birth to decode DNA in service of the God-Host, you have the uncanny ability to consume samples of your defeated foes to learn more about them.

Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes consuming a sample from a fresh corpse or recently defeated foe. You gain a +2 status bonus to your next @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} check to recall information about creatures that share any traits with the consumed creature for the next hour.
Suskillon Cutoff Shirren.name: Suskillon Cutoff Shirren

Swarm Exile Shirren.description:
While most shirrens broke away from the Swarm long ago, you're a more recent convert. You come from a group of castaways that have more in common with the Swarm than most other shirrens.

You gain a bio-cannon ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 20 feet that deals 1d6 acid damage. Your bio-cannon is in the corrosive weapon group. When you select this heritage, choose whether this attack comes from an underslung launcher on one of your arms, a launcher mounted over one of your shoulders, or from your mouth. You can't change this selection.
Swarm Exile Shirren.name: Swarm Exile Shirren

Tabori Trailblazer Orc.description:
You have spent a significant amount of time in the Tabori Cluster or in another place where modern tech doesn't function. You've learned to navigate and survive using technology that many would consider antiquated.

You become trained in Survival. If you would automatically become trained in Survival (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. In addition, you gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.mcl1efgOfMJK1UU9]{Unconventional Weaponry} with any analog weapon of your choice. If you become trained in all martial weapons or guns later on (due to an archetype feat, for example), you can choose an advanced analog weapon at that time to replace your original choice.
Tabori Trailblazer Orc.name: Tabori Trailblazer Orc

Tankmeat Goblin.description: You're genetically modified cannon fodder loyal to the Gideron Authority. While you're @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded}, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds, and your melee Strikes and ranged Strikes with thrown weapons deal persistent bleed damage equal to your combined wounded and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} value.
Tankmeat Goblin.name: Tankmeat Goblin

Teal-Blooded Madrosarai.description:
Of the bloodlines, teal is the most commonly found among madrosarais. This bloodline is known to represent the most dedicated of workers and those seeking to serve their species and the wider needs of the Virtuum. With this blood in your veins, you gain access to a greater resilience that you can employ while performing your duties.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.NAqdTW3tC0eqGiIq]{Madrosarai Tenacity} reaction.
Teal-Blooded Madrosarai.name: Teal-Blooded Madrosarai

Techitin Gnarefuroid.description: Gnarefuroids in regular contact with advanced technology learn to easily integrate it into their bodies. You become trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sEb6KmjQVdWNTqiu]{Augmented Body} general feat.
Techitin Gnarefuroid.name: Techitin Gnarefuroid

Tempering.description: You're undergoing your Tempering, a coming-of-age ritual during which a kasatha rejects the formal traditions of their family and experiences other customs and traditions. You might be one of the Untempered, a kasatha who chooses to continue their Tempering beyond the traditional period. You become trained in Society and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.X2jGFfLU5qI5XVot]{Streetwise} feat.
Tempering.name: Tempering

Test-Subject Ysoki.description:
You're a test-subject ysoki, having survived extensive experiments on your body that have fundamentally altered your physiology. Choose from one of the following test-subject ysoki heritages.

Extra Limbs You have four arms, which allows you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oW81CfM9ebxXnrw3]{Switch Hands} action.

Psychic Augmentation You have a cranial transmitter. You gain limited telepathy, meaning you can communicate mentally with creatures within 30 feet. You can communicate only with creatures that share a language with you. This doesn't give you any access to their thoughts, and it communicates no more information than normal speech would.

Cybernetic Augmentation You're biologically infused with computer hookups. You gain the tech trait and become trained in Computers. If you would automatically become trained in Computers (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You have a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.3TQ2WCBNaFwEUDHo]{datajack} that can't be removed and that doesn't use an augmentation slot, and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.W6Gl9ePmItfDHji0]{Assurance} skill feat for Computers.

Radioactive Exposure to extreme radiation changed your cellular composition. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} from radiation sickness. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.lizh6clVUQm76uvK]{Contaminate} action.
Test-Subject Ysoki.name: Test-Subject Ysoki

Thorny Ikeshti.description: Your scales have bony ridges and spurs, which you can use to defend yourself in a pinch. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6fsMvO0jXtK8gYkH]{Puff Up} reaction.
Thorny Ikeshti.name: Thorny Ikeshti

Thoughtseeker Contemplative.description: Not content with their own thoughts, some contemplatives opened themselves to other minds seeking knowledge throughout the galaxy, developing far-reaching awareness as a result. You are descended from these psychic explorers or trained extensively with their successors. You gain @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.qOLMHvkAGsVYLhtn]{Detect Thoughts} as a 2nd-rank occult innate spell, which you can cast once every 10 minutes. At level 12, you can cast this as a 4th-rank occult innate spell.
Thoughtseeker Contemplative.name: Thoughtseeker Contemplative

Tunnel Runner Trox.description:
During your molting period, you spend weeks of study and disciplined work following a complex regimen of nutrition and exercise, stretching and sculpting the exoskeleton as it forms. As a result, you've rebuilt the protective layer over your body to be lighter and more flexible. Now, you reap the benefits of that work: your lightweight shell is still strong enough to protect you from harm, but it also makes it much easier for you to move around. The walls might still be a bit too close for comfort, but you can maneuver through them more quickly.

Your Speeds increase by 5 feet.
Tunnel Runner Trox.name: Tunnel Runner Trox

Tunnel Ysoki.description: Your incredibly small bones allow you to easily compress your body and squeeze through gaps, whether it's the space between walls to reach a severed data cable or the ductwork of a space station. You gain the Quick Squeeze feat, even if you aren't trained in Acrobatics. Tight spaces not tight enough to require the Squeeze action aren't difficult terrain for you.
Tunnel Ysoki.name: Tunnel Ysoki

Ukara Ryphorian.description:
You're one of the ukara battleflowers from the continent of Ning, warrior-celebrities who leave their families, social standing, and even their genders to train from an early age for extravagant and ritualized combat performances that stun audiences around the galaxy. Being representatives of Ning's culture and mercantile prowess, they're both stoic and fabulous at the same time.

You become trained in Performance. If you would automatically become trained in Performance (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Choose one simple or martial melee weapon or, if you're already trained in all martial weapons, one advanced melee weapon of your choice. While you wield the chosen weapon, it gains the professional (Performance) trait.
Ukara Ryphorian.name: Ukara Ryphorian

Umber-Blooded Madrosarai.description:
A relatively new bloodline that appeared following the Gap, those of the umber bloodline possess powerful psychic abilities that seem linked with events that not even they can remember.

You gain one cantrip from the occult spell list. You can cast this cantrip as an innate occult spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. Replace all instances of arcane or Arcana in all madrosarai ancestry feats you gain with occult and Occultism respectively, including the tradition of all innate spells you gain, the traits of the feats, and the feat's prerequisites.
Umber-Blooded Madrosarai.name: Umber-Blooded Madrosarai

Unbound Lashunta.description: You decided against activating your ancestry's adaptive genetics. You might show a combination of damaya and korasha traits; you might be tall and muscular or short and lithe, or perhaps you have unusual features, such as bumps and swirls covering your body or long, fuzzy antennae. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.j1FsKMy7CTtrp3Fu]{Unbound Mind} reaction.
Unbound Lashunta.name: Unbound Lashunta

Underground Ikeshti.description: Your brood was raised underground to protect the surrounding ecosystem. You're accustomed to darkness and prefer a nocturnal lifestyle when on a planet's surface. You gain darkvision.
Underground Ikeshti.name: Underground Ikeshti

Universal Researcher Mecenaic.description: You've dedicated one of your life phases to expanding your understanding of the universe around you. Your mind is limber, and your expertise is impressive, if specialized. You're trained in a skill of your choice that has the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} action. You've taken more than one math class over the years and learned the value of a good estimate. You can immediately learn the number of visually similar items in a group you can see, rounded to the first digit in the total number.
Universal Researcher Mecenaic.name: Universal Researcher Mecenaic

Urban Shobhad.description: You live in a city or other densely populated area and, after a lot of trial and error, have found your niche, becoming a productive citizen in equilibrium with your community. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.YtbPw4FSa86QAdRq]{Urban Survivalist} skill feat even if you aren't trained in Survival. You have a +2 circumstance bonus on any downtime checks you make to Craft or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}.
Urban Shobhad.name: Urban Shobhad

Urbanite Human.description: You have grown up in a big city and are accustomed to the press and pull of the largest crowds, the electric buzz and tangle of streets, or the dense nature of vertical living on a station or megaplex. You ignore difficult terrain from crowds and lesser cover from crowds. You become trained in a Lore skill for one specific city of your choice.
Urbanite Human.name: Urbanite Human

Vali Maraquoi.description:
In the shadow of Ouat Vali, the Shining City, isolationist maraquoi tribes train their youth who wish to preserve thousands of years of history and an ancient way of life. These isolationists have learned to mistrust outsiders and to use the tools of their ancestors with incredible precision. You come from a tribe that has, at least in part, rejected the call to join galactic society.

You become trained in Warfare Lore. If you would automatically become trained in Warfare Lore (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You gain access and familiarity with an archaic or analog weapon of your choice. For the purposes of proficiency, you treat that martial weapon as a simple weapon, or that advanced weapon as a martial weapon. If you're trained in all martial weapons or guns from your class, you can choose an uncommon advanced weapon instead. You gain access to that weapon, and for purposes of determining your proficiency, that weapon is a martial weapon.
Vali Maraquoi.name: Vali Maraquoi

Venomthought Vesk.description: You're one of the notable vesk born with psychic talents. According to folklore, your lineage originated with an ancient cave-dwelling society on Vesk Prime who modified themselves with occult rituals, which granted them "venomous thoughts" that could manifest in any future progeny. You can cast daze as an occult innate cantrip at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Occultism checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about psychic traditions and philosophies.
Venomthought Vesk.name: Venomthought Vesk

Versatile Human.description: Humans were the most common ancestry on Golarion before that world disappeared, and they've since spread to the stars thanks to their versatility. Select a general feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites (as with your ancestry feat, you can select this general feat at any point during character creation).
Versatile Human.name: Versatile Human

Vital Spark Novian.description:
Yours is a life-giving flame, nourishing all who bask in your glow. It's likely your progenitor star contained a portal to Creation's Forge or was a site of importance to a deity or other powerful cosmic being.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.NhqAjQ2qP6a2G1Sk]{Nourishing Light} action.
Vital Spark Novian.name: Vital Spark Novian

Void Acolyte Kasatha.description:
Not every kasatha boarded the Idari. Some solarians believed that since their planet was to be no more, the only place kasathas truly belonged was in the vastness of space. Nomadic by nature and survivalist by necessity, these ascetics embraced the void. A new tradition emerged in which kasatha solarians trained themselves to float in vacuum while meditating on the concepts of form and emptiness. Growing up in one of these families, you're experienced in void meditation.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.aJUXbe9HJVvv0Mxa]{Breath Control} general feat. You aren't @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} while @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered}.
Void Acolyte Kasatha.name: Void Acolyte Kasatha

Void Hermit Gnome.description:
Your ancestors once lived underground, hiding away from the light. Now you take that instinct to its astral extreme, seeking the dark sides of moons, the deepest craters, and the blackest nebulae, places where the noise and light of society can't get in. While some void hermits merely seek solitude to consider heady problems in peace, others pursue the twisted, eldritch knowledge of malicious fey and outer gods to the deepest, darkest corners of the galaxy. Only you know what you hope to find there in the dark.

You learn the Aklo language and become trained in Occultism. If you would automatically become trained in Occultism (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain the cosmic trait.
Void Hermit Gnome.name: Void Hermit Gnome

Voidborn Pahtra.description: Your shimmering black coat acts as a sort of natural space suit that's especially visible on the infrared spectrum. While in a vacuum, you temporarily gain the cosmic trait. Creatures with the cosmic trait don't need to breathe while in space or a vacuum and are immune to the harmful effects of being in space. You also gain darkvision.
Voidborn Pahtra.name: Voidborn Pahtra

Voidcore Android.description:
Your body is powered by a voidcore: an ancient marvel of technology with shrouded origins, older than most things in the galaxy. The first voidcores were constructed to power far larger equipment, but eventually they found their way into the heart of androids as an operational enhancement to existing cores. Today, voidcore androids are created by harnessing entropy through a ritual of corruption that calls on the Void. This influx of entropy reverses the energy state of the android, inverting the soul itself in the process. You're a voidcore android, with black, blue, or violet energy surging through your circuitry.

You have void healing, which means you're damaged by vitality damage and not healed by healing vitality effects, and you don't take void damage and are healed by void effects that heal undead. You gain darkvision.
Voidcore Android.name: Voidcore Android

Volatile Novian.description:
Your chemical composition is incredibly volatile, and like the supernova that birthed you, you're ready to go out with a bang!

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.KhX0FDMxGVgHjXdU]{Mini-Nova} reaction.
Volatile Novian.name: Volatile Novian

Vorlathi Worlanisi.description:
A group of worlanisi who rebelled against the brutal experimentation of the Reivolan Institute 20 years ago have formed the Vault of Vorlath, one of the most efficient and successful mercenary factions in Near Space. These survivors have been augmented with cybernetics, trained in military tactics, and conditioned to be cunning, aggressive soldiers who are known throughout the galaxy for their fighting prowess. Over the years since the Vault's formation, the Vorlathi have recruited worlanisi fortunauts and other promising soldiers, augmenting their bodies and sharpening their minds for combat while sparing them the brutality of the Reivolan Institute's experimentation. The Vorlathi mercenaries refuse to rely on their luck for protection, striving to be prepared for even the unluckiest scenarios. You were either a member of the original rebellion or were recruited later on.

Your body has been customized with cybernetics. You're trained in Crafting. If you would automatically become trained in Crafting (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.sEb6KmjQVdWNTqiu]{Augmented Body} feat.
Vorlathi Worlanisi.name: Vorlathi Worlanisi

Wanderer and Friend Phasorq.description: It's a pirate's, or at least a vagabond's, life for you. You've learned the value of a first impression and worked hard to cultivate your opening pitch. The fact that you can hold two conversations at once certainly helps, especially when meeting groups. You're trained in Diplomacy and gain the Group Impression skill feat. If you would already be trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example) you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.
Wanderer and Friend Phasorq.name: Wanderer and Friend Phasorq

Warblood Vesk.description: You come from a bloodline of renowned and honored warriors who have honed their bodies over centuries to become lethal weapons. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.s7QK7Q63k9SxG106]{Brutal Anatomy} ancestry feat twice.
Warblood Vesk.name: Warblood Vesk

Waste Walker Nuar.description: Your fur grows in muted shades perfectly suited for blending in with the sands of desert planets. You gain fire resistance equal to half your level. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Stealth to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]] in desert environments.
Waste Walker Nuar.name: Waste Walker Nuar

Wavecrested Vesk.description: You come from a world of warm seas and primal magic that has caused your body to develop soft scales, a wide head, and frilled gill stalks. You gain a swim Speed of 20 feet, and you gain the amphibious trait, enabling you to breathe in water and air.
Wavecrested Vesk.name: Wavecrested Vesk

Whispered Record Halfling.description:
You're a living record of halfling history, memorizing and passing on historical records of the exploits of halflings all over the galaxy, both old and new. These records might take the form of a didactic poem that recants a halfling's ordeals against the dangers of imprudence or a long, plainly worded record, (like a journal) of a halfling's time as a soldier.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.BocFD2KV0qgUC76x]{Additional Lore} feat for Halfling Lore. Once per day, you can @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about any topic using Halfling Lore with a –2 circumstance penalty.
Whispered Record Halfling.name: Whispered Record Halfling

Wild Astrazoan.description: While most astrazoans flock to communities in densely populated settlements, some choose to live among nature in the wilderness, forging their own destiny or even defending their paradise from the influence of others. You have only one ancestry you can select for Change Shape, but you can also use Change Shape to transform into an animal with the statistics of a 1st-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gfPjmG6Fe6D3MFjl]{Pest Form}.
Wild Astrazoan.name: Wild Astrazoan

Wildseed.description: You germinated far from the ancestral groves of other khizars. You might have grown up in a small transplant grove or maybe you were cultivated in a laboratory. Select an ancestry or versatile heritage to represent part of your unconventional upbringing. Once chosen it cannot be changed. At 1st level, you gain an additional ancestry feat from the chosen ancestry or heritage. Whenever you gain an ancestry feat, you may choose that feat from the ancestry or heritage.
Wildseed.name: Wildseed

Winged Bantrid.description: You have a rare mutation that causes the appendages most bantrids use as hands to instead grow into magnificent wings. Fortunately, your foot orb is smaller than that of other bantrids, which frees up some of your cilia that can operate together like a pair of hands. Your Speed is 20 feet, and you gain a 20-foot fly Speed.
Winged Bantrid.name: Winged Bantrid

Winged Shirren.description: Your ancestors were members of the Swarm who evolved wings. You possess a fully functional pair of wings that grant you a fly Speed of 15 feet.
Winged Shirren.name: Winged Shirren

Winter Coat Vlaka.description: Your thick fur keeps you warm in cold places like Lajok. You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
Winter Coat Vlaka.name: Winter Coat Vlaka

Winterborn Ryphorian.description:
You have thicker skin than your summerborn cousins, topped with layers of white fur. In addition, your eyes are noticeably narrower so to avoid becoming snow-blind. Winterborn ryphorians are traditionally known to be gruff but loyal to a fault, especially when it comes to promises and oaths sworn to others. Some of these stereotypes are just that, and just as many winterborn progressives dye their fur out of artistic expression rather than to exist solely in a stodgy, stark-white state.

You gain cold resistance equal to half your level (minimum 1). You treat environmental cold effects as if they were one step less extreme (incredible cold becomes extreme, extreme cold becomes severe, and so on).
Winterborn Ryphorian.name: Winterborn Ryphorian

Worker Formian.description:
You're a worker formian, the most common kind of formian found in any settlement. Responsible for hauling food and construction materials, delivering messages, assisting builders, carrying fallen soldiers, and countless other tasks, workers form the backbone of formian society.

As a worker formian, you become trained in Athletics. If you would automatically become trained in Athletics (such as from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Additionally, your Speed is 30 feet, and you can carry an additional 5 Bulk beyond your normal limits before becoming encumbered or overburdened.
Worker Formian.name: Worker Formian

Wyrd Kasatha.description:
Some Great Families of Kasath maintain close relationships with witchwyrds, a group of insular alien merchants who wander the galaxy and outer planes conducting trade. You're a descendant of one such family, and you've grown up learning traditional magical techniques.

You can cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage} as a 1st-rank arcane innate spell once per day. In addition, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Hq7duW66un55uGoA]{Deflect Force} reaction.
Wyrd Kasatha.name: Wyrd Kasatha

Xenofey Gnome.description:
Your affinity for the natural world helps you see the connections between organisms no matter the environment you're in. Xenofey gnomes often search out uncolonized planets where they can live in balance with the natural world or join terraforming colonies, utilizing both their mechanical and magical mastery to spread life across the galaxy. Many xenofey gnomes revel in the discovery of new species and show a keen interest in the fantastical creatures of alien planets and deep space.

You become trained in Nature. If you would automatically become trained in Nature (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. Once per day, if you're on a planet, you can gain the ability to speak and understand a language that is commonly spoken by the people on it. You lose this knowledge during your next daily preparations.
Xenofey Gnome.name: Xenofey Gnome

Xenometric Android.description: You're a constructed version of a non-human ancestry. You gain the android trait, in addition to the trait associated with the ancestry you resemble. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.ancestry-features.Item.mnhmhOKWLiOD0lev]{Constructed} ability but not the low-light vision ability of androids. In addition, your size category and reach changes to match the chosen ancestry. You can select from android feats up to 13th level, any of the feats of the ancestry you resemble, or xenometric android feats whenever you gain an ancestry feat. Choose a heritage from your ancestry, but you don't gain its mechanical benefits. The xenometric android heritage shouldn't be taken by a member of a constructed ancestry, such as android, or a human.
Xenometric Android.name: Xenometric Android

Xenoresponsive Gnarefuroid.description: Gnarefuroids who dwell in natural environments become attuned to organic energies, especially those of decay and rot. Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast this spell as a primal innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Xenoresponsive Gnarefuroid.name: Xenoresponsive Gnarefuroid

Yeulentu.description: You joined with a yeuloise, a land tortoise from Saaruq-5. You keep yourself upright with subtle shifts of unconscious telekinesis controlled by your vestibular system. Your size is Large instead of Small, and you gain 8 Hit Points from your ancestry instead of 6. You gain an attribute boost to Intelligence instead of Wisdom.
Yeulentu.name: Yeulentu

Zabanii Po Talphi.description:
Before the Veskarium came, talphis had easygoing relationships with shuzrians and ausyrs they shared the planet with, centered on their ability to communicate easily with one another. After the invasion, and the subsequent introduction of a galaxy of other peoples and languages, many talphis have carried this tradition into a much larger stage. The eager-to-please talphis often have a knack for picking up new languages quickly, and zabaniis have become highly sought-after translators for many different factions.

You've learned that it's important to always be able to converse with your neighbors, and much of your early education has been devoted to communicating with diverse groups. You become trained in Society. If you would automatically become trained in Society (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. Additionally, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.MeBVpW5EIOzoEHCh]{Linguistic Prodigy} standardized ancestry feat.
Zabanii Po Talphi.name: Zabanii Po Talphi

Zero-G Atraxid.description: You feel perfectly at home where there's no gravity. Atraxids were early adopters of space flight among the Szandite Collective, and many atraxids took to it readily, thriving in a zero-g environment. You do not gain the clumsy and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} conditions due to being @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.z1ucw4CLwLqHoAp3]{Untethered} in zero gravity, though you can still gain those conditions due to other effects.
Zero-G Atraxid.name: Zero-G Atraxid
